title: Project Manager or Project Officer Biomass Value Chains (f/m/d)
description:
Agora Industry Are you passionate about biomass feedstocks as a means to decarbonise heavy industry applications? Do you bring expertise in the technical, economic and climate policy aspects of biomass availability, processing and use? Are you excited to work in a diverse, multi-disciplinary and international team? Then, this is the perfect opportunity for you!
Reaching a climate-neutral industry will require unprecedented investments in a wide range of GHG mitigation technologies, due to the sector’s inherent complexity and regional diversity. While a significant share of emissions can be reduced by advancing energy efficiency and expanding direct electrification powered by renewable energy, there is also the need for more complex and costly measures as well as alternative feedstocks for processes, where biomass and hydrogen technologies can be implemented. To tap into this potential, climate-effective biomass uses in industry require thorough understanding of availability and costs across different regions to give recommendations on policies that help to decarbonise industry in a competitive way, incorporating ecological sustainability boundaries. Under the umbrella of the Agora Think Tanks, Agora Industry develops politically feasible and science-based strategies and solutions for the transformation to climate neutrality – in Germany, Europe, and internationally. As a think tank and policy lab we facilitate a productive exchange of ideas amongst stakeholders from politics, business, science and civil society. As a non-partisan, non-profit organisation funded by foundations and public institutions, we are independent of corporate and partisan interests. Our exclusive mission is to serve the climate and the common good.To strengthen our team, we are looking for a

Project Manager or Project Officer Biomass Value Chains (f/m/d) 
Full- or part-time (min. 32 hours)– based in Berlin 

You will work on the supply side of biomass as a feedstock for hard-to-electrify applications in industry. The geographical scope will be global, covering different conditions and contexts that vary across geographies. This position is part of Agora Industry’s central Technologies & Analysis team, working closely with regional teams.

Your responsibilities include - Contributing to the development and implementation of international projects focused on climate-effective biomass solutions for industrial decarbonisation, encompassing farm- and forest-level availability, logistics and conversion technologies, as well as biomass supply for industrial carbon dioxide removal (CDR).
- Analysing biomass supply costs, availability and potentials for different agriculture and forestry products across multiple geographies, taking into account competing uses in different sectors and market implications. 
- Conducting and coordinating projects on biomass for industrial applications and related technological enablers and policy support mechanisms
- Analysing policy and regulatory gaps that hinder biomass use in various regions with a focus on economic, regulatory, and governance frameworks. 
- Monitoring the development of technology and business models related to the scaling, mobilization and system integration of biomass value chains and logistics. 
- Supporting stakeholder engagement with policymakers, industry, civil society, funders, among others, to inform discussions around biomass applications across different industry sectors.
- Pro-actively contributing to building partnerships and working closely with network partners across the globe. 
- Liaising with expert colleagues across the Agora Think Tanks (including Agora Agriculture) to facilitate their contributions to projects and knowledge sharing across different regions.
- Actively contributing to internal discussions.
- Managing subcontractors including preparing agreements and work plans, supervising and guiding project progress, and managing the quality of deliverables.
- As Project Officer, the focus is on contributing to the technical management of specific projects with smaller budget, largely independent research, contributing to the conceptualisation and development of complex topics, and of project-related reporting and communication. 
- As Project Manager , the focus is on technical management and responsibility for specific projects with smaller budgets, independent comprehensive research, conceptualisation and development of complex topics, technical supervision of students and interns, and project-related reporting and communication.

We are looking for - A Master’s degree in energy, environmental engineering or forestry/agriculture engineering, natural sciences, renewable energies, agricultural economist, or similar 
- As Project Officer : Preferably 2 years of experience (including internships, student work or post-graduate roles) in the field of quantitative analysis of biomass systems.
- As Project Manager : At least 4 years of overall professional experience, with 2 years specifically in the field of biomass
- A proven track record and expertise in biomass supply cost, transport logistics and conversion technologies. 
- Solid knowledge of the farming and forestry sectors.
- Familiarity with agricultural systems and ideally forest systems in different world regions is a plus. 
- Good background understanding of industrial transformation is a plus.
- Experience with Life-Cycle Assessment is a plus. 
- Familiarity with sustainable biomass certification and deforestation-free frameworks is a plus.
- Strong networking skills and the ability to engage with business, industry associations, research partners and policy makers.
- A creative and result-oriented mind, capable of developing new ideas and proposals with a view to having impact.
- Outstanding communication skills, both verbal and written; track-record in writing high quality documents.
- Full command of the English language in reading and writing, knowledge of other languages is a plus.
- Willingness to travel outside Europe. 

We assume that there are excellent candidates for the job who do not meet all the criteria in the description. Maybe you have certain skills we haven’t thought of yet? Tell us why you are the right person for the job.

What we offer - An opportunity to work in a mission-driven, highly motivated, and professional international team.
- Opportunities for professional growth and advancement; including access to a mental well-being platform.
- Flexible working hours and a hybrid work environment, with access to an attractive office space in central Berlin and a good setup to work from home.
- Weekly breakfast, team events and other get-togethers with colleagues from around the globe.
- One option from our benefit basket (e.g. job ticket, shopping vouchers, Urban Sports, etc.).
- Opportunities for professional and personal development and advancement.
- Entitlement of 29 paid leave days per year (5-days working week); 24th & 31st December off-work.
- A cooperative working atmosphere with flat communication and decision-making hierarchies.
- Assistance with visa and work permits for international candidates if required.
- A structured onboarding programme and regular team and organisation-wide retreats to bring us all together; and 
- A full or part-time role, initially limited to two years.

you are the right person for the job.

We want an energy transition for everyone from everyone. Therefore, we are particularly
pleased to receive applications from people from groups that have been underrepresented
in energy and industrial policy. We welcome applications regardless of gender and gender identity,

title: Freie Mitarbeit Presse und Öffentlichkeitsarbeit auf Honorarbasis
description:
JEWLIF – Jüdisches Leben in Europa e. V. mit Sitz in Köln stärkt jüdisches Leben in Deutschland und Europa durch Projekte in Bildung, Wissenschaft, Kunst, Kultur und Medienkompetenz. Für Oktober bis Dezember 2026 suchen wir eine erfahrene selbstständige Fachkraft für Presse, PR und Kommunikation für projektbezogene Aufträge.

Aufgaben

Je nach Anlass vereinbaren wir mit dir einzelne Leistungspakete:

· Pressemitteilungen: Recherche, Texterstellung und Überarbeitung nach Briefing, mit Zitat des Generalsekretärs, Boilerplate und Förderhinweis sowie bis zu zwei Korrekturrunden, einschließlich einer Fassung für unsere Website. Bei Bedarf ergänzt um die Ansprache ausgewählter Redaktionen und einen kurzen Resonanzbericht.

· Pressemappen: Aufbereitung von Informationen zu JEWLIF und einzelnen Maßnahmen mit Factsheets, Hintergrundtexten, FAQ und Bildmaterial. mit geklärten Bildrechten.

· Newsletter: Sammeln von Informationen aus unseren Projekten, Redigieren der Texte sowie Auswahl und Bearbeitung passender Bilder mit geklärten Nutzungsrechten. Du setzt jede Ausgabe vollständig in unserer bestehenden Brevo-Vorlage auf und bereitest sie zur Freigabe vor.

· Social Media: Entwicklung von Redaktionsplänen sowie Text und Gestaltung einer vereinbarten Anzahl von Beiträgen, bei Bedarf einschließlich Veröffentlichung.

· Presseanfragen und Veranstaltungen: Recherche und Antwortentwürfe zu einzelnen Anfragen mit Dokumentation in einem Anfrageprotokoll sowie Vorbereitung konkreter Pressetermine mit Einladung, Ablauf, Sprechzettel und Hintergrundinformationen.

· Dokumentation: Erstellung kurzer Checklisten für Presseabläufe (Pressemitteilung, Pressetermin, Presseanfrage und Erstreaktion bei kritischer Berichterstattung) und geordnete Übergabe der erarbeiteten Materialien mit einem abschließenden Übergabegespräch.

Die Zusammenarbeit:

Umfang, Ergebnisse, Termine und Honorar stimmen wir für jedes Leistungspaket vorab miteinander ab. Du setzt die vereinbarten Leistungen eigenverantwortlich mit eigener Ausstattung um und gestaltest Arbeitsort und Arbeitszeit selbst. Für Briefings, Rückfragen und Freigaben steht dir eine feste Ansprechperson zur Verfügung. Alles, was nach außen geht, gibt der Generalsekretär frei. Unser CI-Handbuch, unsere Vorlagen und Boilerplates stellen wir dir zur Verfügung.

Der voraussichtliche Gesamtumfang liegt bei bis zu 36 Leistungstagen im genannten Zeitraum. Die Beauftragung erfolgt nach Bedarf und gemeinsamer Vereinbarung. Abgerechnet wird monatlich nach Tagesnachweis mit Zuordnung zu den Leistungspaketen.

Qualifikation

Du hast mindestens drei Jahre Erfahrung in Pressearbeit, PR oder Journalismus und formulierst sicher und verständlich auf Deutsch. Du arbeitest selbstständig und kannst aussagekräftige Referenzen vorweisen. Erfahrungen mit gemeinnützigen Organisationen, eigene Kontakte zu Redaktionen sowie Kenntnisse jüdischen Lebens und der Debatte um Antisemitismus sind willkommen, ebenso Erfahrung mit Newsletter-Tools wie Brevo.

Dein Angebot:

Wir freuen uns bis zum 28. September 2026, 12 Uhr, über dein Angebot über JOIN mit:

· einem kurzen Profil (höchstens zwei Seiten) und deiner Verfügbarkeit,

· zwei Arbeitsproben und zwei Referenzprojekten mit Ansprechperson,

· deinem Stunden- und/oder Tagessatz, beim Tagessatz mit Angabe der enthaltenen Stunden,

· gerne ergänzenden Paketpreisen mit kurzer Beschreibung der enthaltenen Leistungen.

Bitte gib an, welche Aufgabenpakete du übernehmen möchtest. Preise bitten wir netto zuzüglich gegebenenfalls anfallender Umsatzsteuer anzugeben; mögliche Reise- und Nebenkosten bitte gesondert ausweisen. Fragen vorab beantwortet Rebecca Westerschulze, Bei der Auswahl berücksichtigen wir Preis, Qualität der Arbeitsproben sowie einschlägige Erfahrung und Referenzen. title: Product Manager, Delivery Promise
description:
About Wolt 

At Wolt, we create technology that brings joy, simplicity and earnings to the neighborhoods of the world. In 2014 we started with delivery of restaurant food. Now we're building the delivery of (almost) everything and you'll find us in over 500 cities in 30 countries around the world. In 2022 we joined forces with DoorDash and together we keep on dreaming big and expanding across the globe.

Working at Wolt isn't always easy, but it's definitely exciting. Here you'll learn more, build more, and ship more than in most other companies. You'll be challenged a lot, but also have a lot of fun on the way. So, if you're a self-starter with drive and entrepreneurial spirit, this could be the ride of your life. 

We are looking for a Product Manager to join our Product Management organization, working with the Delivery Promise team. This is one of those parts of Wolt's business that people don't always realize the complexity of. Logistics is absolutely integral to Wolt, and doing it well can mean the difference between delivering blissful customer experiences efficiently and profitably vs. operational nightmares and a cacophony of late deliveries. 

The Delivery Promise team is in the Courier & Logistics Product group at Wolt. We're driving the future with estimates that fuel our growth, flywheel, shaping shopping decisions and streamlining deliveries. Our goal: boost Wolt's growth and profitability by delivering reliable, precise time estimates to customers and partners worldwide. In a nutshell, the team is responsible for crafting accurate and reliable time estimates that form a key part of the pre-checkout purchase experience for our consumers, right from discovery to checkout. We employ advanced machine learning models and innovative tools to craft delivery estimates experienced by consumers across all business lines for Wolt. 

As the Product Manager for the Delivery Promise team, your role will be integral in ensuring that we provide the best delivery estimates for our consumers while balancing the operational impact of fulfilling deliveries against the promised estimates. You will be contributing significantly to Wolt's goal of delightful customer experiences. 

Join us in shaping the future of delivery, where every delivery is an opportunity for delight and loyalty.

Our humble expectations 

You could come to this role from various backgrounds, but ideally, you bring:

- Plenty of previous experience as a Product Manager 

- It's a plus for you if you have a background in Machine Learning or Data Science, since you would be focused on optimizing our estimates across markets and consumer cohorts. 

- Proven track record in building products influencing cross-functional teams, including engineering, data, design, and operations.

- High ownership and collaborative capabilities, making thoughtful decisions, and focusing on product details to ensure execution aligns with the vision.

- Strong ability to define, execute, and measure meaningful OKRs, ensuring alignment with company-wide goals and fostering bottom-up alignment from your team.

- Ability to focus on the bigger picture, creating solutions that benefit couriers, operations, and customer experiences across the organization.

- Excellent stakeholder management skills, able to work effectively with diverse internal teams and external partners, while confidently engaging with leadership in a high-visibility role.

The position will be filled as soon as we find the right person, so make sure to apply as soon as you realize you really, really want to join us!

The compensation will be a negotiable combination of monthly pay and DoorDash RSUs. The latter makes it exceptionally easy to be excited about our company growing and doing well, as you'll own a piece of the pie.

Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion 

We're committed to growing and empowering a more inclusive community within our company, industry, and cities. That's why we hire and cultivate diverse teams of people from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We believe that true innovation happens when everyone has room at the table and the tools, resources, and opportunity to excel. 

Beware of recruitment scams: DoorDash, Deliveroo, and Wolt will never ask you to pay money or share sensitive financial information during hiring — learn more about our legitimate recruiting process at Recruitment Scam Awareness - DoorDash .

- Sie übernehmen die aktive Führung eines kleinen Teams und entwickeln die Zusammenarbeit mit internen und externen Stakeholdern weiter

Qualifikation

- Sie haben ein abgeschlossenes Studium mit Schwerpunkt Controlling/Finanzen oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation sowie mehrjährige Berufs- und Führungserfahrung im Controlling eines internationalen und produzierenden Unternehmens

- Sie bewegen sich in der deutschen und englischen Sprache im beruflichen Umfeld sehr sicher

- Sie zeichnen sich durch ein ausgeprägtes Verständnis für ganzheitliche Prozesse und wirtschaftliche Zusammenhänge aus und bringen die Bereitschaft, Veränderungsprozesse maßgeblich voranzutreiben auch mit

- Sie schaffen es mit ihrer Kommunikationsstärke, Durchsetzungsvermögen und einem ausgeprägten Team-Spirit die Integration von Prozessen und Systemen mit den Menschen zu schaffenSie kommen mit ihrer eigenverantwortlichen, strukturierten und ergebnisorientierte Arbeitsweise ans Ziel

title: Senior Business Intelligence Lead (all genders)
description:
Your Mission EV charging is evolving from a niche technology into everyday infrastructure. As reev grows, teams increasingly need reliable, consistently defined metrics. Today, different dashboards, reporting dates, filters, and assumptions can produce different answers to the same business question. 
This role addresses the problem - not by building more dashboards, but by creating a shared and trustworthy data foundation. The goal is to establish clear definitions and consistent metrics so that teams and leadership can make informed decisions based on the same numbers. Someone who understands that unclear definitions, rather than a lack of data, are often the real problem can make a significant impact in this role. You own the certified layer, the single, agreed upon version of every core metric that reev runs on. You connect the definition, the data model, and the delivery. And when two numbers disagree, you are the person who says which one to trust. 

What you will do 
- Define core metrics with Finance, Product, Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, Engineering, and Platform. 
- Agree on definitions , data contracts, and ownership forcore metrics with the teams that own them. 
- Maintain and verify the certified data layer , built in ETL tooland surfaced in Metabase, so teams can build their own dashboards on top of it. 
- Use SQL to validate data , investigate inconsistencies, and trace numbers back to their sources. 
- Work with Platform team to identify potential improvements in data flows, pipelines, and transformations, advise on next steps, and help prioritize next steps during planning. 
- Help stakeholders decide which number to trust when reports disagree. 
- Improve data literacy through practical guidance, workshops, and clear documentation. 
- Use AI-assisted tools for analysis, documentation, automation, and workflows. Check the results carefully. 

What this role is not 
You will not be the central owner of every dashboard request. Teams remain responsible for their own dashboards, analyses, and data models built on their data contracts. This is also not a classic infrastructure or people-management role. 

What you bring along Must-have 
- Senior experience in BI , analytics, or data. Scale-up experience is helpful. 
- Strong SQL skills .You can read and write SQL ,validate data, and trace where a number comes from. 
- Experience defining KPIs with Finance and other business owners. 
- Experience with data models , data quality , or data governance. 
- A good understanding of data flows, pipelines, and transformations. 
- Confidence working with senior stakeholders and challenging unclear or incorrect numbers. 
- A hands-on , business-minded approach . You connect business questions with practical data solutions. 
- Experience with automation , AI Agents , or AI-supported workflows . 
- Fluent written and spoken English, German is a plus. 
Nice to have 
- Experience with Metabase , dbt , AWS Glue , Spark , Airbyte , or comparable tools. 
- Experience with workshops, enablement, or data literacy programmes. 
- Experience in B2B SaaS , EV charging , energy , mobility, or a related field. 
You do not need every tool on the list. We care most about strong SQL , sound data thinking , and the ability to bring people to one shared definition .

What you can expect from us How we work 
Clear goals, real ownership, and little politics. We move quickly, decide together, and hold each other accountable.

Where you will work 
Our Munich office at Stiglmaierplatz is an important place for collaboration. For this role, we expect at least three days on-site each week. 

What you get 
- 28 vacation days - Plus additional days off between Christmas and New Year. Good work starts with proper rest. 
- Mental health , taken seriously - Free access to the nilo platform with individual sessions from psychologists and business coaches. We want you balanced, not just productive. 
- AI tools - no limits - Every person and every team at reev uses the AI tools they choose, without budget constraints. We believe in working with the best tools available, and we don't slow that down.

- Represent the finance team at the Credit Risk Working Group and Risk and Compliance Committee.

- Building robust financial control processes and strengthening internal controls.

- Maintain strong balance sheet controls with monthly substantiation.

- Maintaining relationships with external auditors, tax advisors and accounting advisors.

- Identifying opportunities to streamline and improve accounting processes, operations and systems.

Why be the Head of Data Engineering and Governance at THG? 

THG is building a world-class data function to power one of the UK's largest e-commerce businesses. As Head of Engineering & Governance, you will own the quality, availability and structure of the data that enables every business-facing team across our Beauty and Nutrition divisions.

This is not a systems infrastructure role. You are not managing foundational platform plumbing — that sits with our technology partner, Ingenuity. Your remit is the layer above that: how data is structured, governed, made available and used across the business. You will set the direction for how THG gets the most from its data ecosystem, ensuring that analytics teams, data scientists, and business leaders can trust and act on the data they see.

You will lead three distinct functions: Engineering (how we build, structure and maintain our data domains), Governance (how we ensure quality, consistency and trust), and Reporting (how we present business performance data consistently across PLC). You will work closely with Ingenuity, who provide the foundational platform and first-layer pipelines, to set requirements and standards that flow through from ingestion to insight.

We are at an early stage of this journey. Our data foundations need significant work — we have talented analysts who have been doing engineering work without the structure or tools to do it well, governance that is essentially non-existent, and reporting that has grown organically without consistency. You will shape and deliver the roadmap that fixes this.

What you'll do: 

Strategic Direction 

- Set the vision and roadmap for data engineering, governance and reporting across THG PLC

- Define how data domains (Customer, Commercial, Operations) should be structured, stored and made available for analytics, data science and AI use cases

- Own the relationship with Ingenuity on platform and data matters — setting requirements, managing dependencies and ensuring PLC needs are reflected in the Ingen roadmap

Engineering & Data Platform 

- Lead the Engineering team in building and maintaining the data pipelines, domain datasets and platform architecture that underpin analytics across Beauty and Nutrition

- Champion the use of AI and automation in data engineering — this is a small team that needs to move fast, and we expect the use of AI-assisted pipeline development and management to be embedded in how we work

Data Governance 

- Lead the Data Governance function from a standing start — we have no established governance framework and this is a greenfield opportunity to build it properly

- Own the framework for how THG manages data quality, metadata, data definitions and lineage across PLC

- Work with Ingenuity to ensure governance standards are consistent across both PLC and Ingen data infrastructure

- Build the culture and processes that make governance a positive enabler rather than a compliance burden

Reporting & BI 

- Own the consistency and quality of all business performance reporting across THG PLC — dashboards, KPI reports, executive-level views

- Lead the evolution of our Tableau estate and assess when alternative or complementary tooling should be introduced

title: Senior Data Scientist
description:
Clarity Innovations is a trusted national security partner, dedicated to safeguarding our nation’s interests and delivering innovative solutions that empower the Intelligence Community (IC) and Department of Defense (DoD) to transform data into actionable intelligence, ensuring mission success in an evolving world.

Our mission-first software and data engineering platform modernizes data operations, utilizing advanced workflows, CI/CD, and secure DevSecOps practices. We focus on challenges in Information Warfare, Cyber Operations, Operational Security, and Data Structuring, enabling end-to-end solutions that drive operational impact.

We are committed to delivering cutting-edge tools and capabilities that address the most complex national security challenges, empowering our partners to stay ahead of emerging threats and ensuring the success of their critical missions. At Clarity, we are people-focused and set on being a destination employer for top talent, offering an environment where innovation thrives, careers grow, and individuals are valued. Join us as we continue to lead innovation and tackle the most pressing challenges in national security.

Role 

This role is for a Data Scientist on a close-knit team supporting Air Force Special Operations Command (AFSOC) at RAF Mildenhall, UK. This team is at the center of helping the command empower and leverage its data for more effective analysis and decision making. As a subject matter expert, the Data Scientist will leverage their experience to gather and derive insights from complex data, assist the command with development initiatives, and facilitate digital transformation efforts. The work done in this role has a direct impact on mission readiness as the team's efforts go toward making a more resilient and data-driven organization.

Responsibilities 

A Data Scientist will have skills sets of both data analysts and data engineers. Data scientists are responsible for designing, implementing, and maintaining a data pipeline. In addition, data scientists shall interpret and analyze complex sets of data, as well as plan, execute, and manage ML projects with cloud-native platforms and advanced ML solutions. They understand some of the most challenging processes, technologies, and can leverage a vast array of methodologies in the field, such as data mining, natural language programming, and machine learning. 

Data scientists must have a combination of skills that includes programming, mathematical modeling, statistics, and domain knowledge. They must combine an advanced math and statistics background with programming, domain knowledge, and communication skills to analyze data, create applied mathematical models, and present results in a form useful to the organization. They must also be able to understand and manipulate structured and unstructured large data sets, which requires proficiency in distributed SQL programming, relational and non-relational data queries, general programming languages (such as Python and R,) and machine learning techniques.

The Data Scientist shall perform the following tasks: 
• Interpret and analyze data using exploratory mathematic and statistical techniques based on the scientific method.
• Coordinate research and analytic activities utilizing various data points (unstructured and structured) and employ programming to clean, massage, and organize the data
• Experiment against data points, provide information based on experiment results and provide previously undiscovered solutions to command data challenges.
• Coordinate with Data Engineers to build Data environments providing data identified by other data professionals
• Apply and develop scientific methodology, statistics, and algorithms to discover and frame relevant problems, hypotheses, and opportunities. 
• Develop predictive and prescriptive modeling, natural language processing (NLP), Robotic Process Automation (RPA), text mining and processing, clustering, forecasting methods, and other advanced statistical techniques.
• Design and automate processes to facilitate the manipulation and analysis of data. Manage and integrate data across dissimilar data sets. Analyze large-scale structured and unstructured data. 
• Use frameworks such as Spark and Hadoop to conduct large-scale data processing. Perform statistical modeling and create data visualizations using products like Tableau, Microsoft Power BI and R Shiny. 
• Research, design, and implement algorithms to solve complex problems. Program using R, Python (NumPy, SciPy, Pandas) or similar analytical languages. 
• Perform data engineering, data processing and modeling techniques using cloud-based data management, data science, and ML platforms such as Databricks, IBM Cloud Pak, Cloudera, and Snowflake.
• Communicate complex concepts and hypothesis to a non-technical audience through digital storytelling.

Requirements 

- A minimum of 1 year of hands-on Data Science experience is required.

- Bachelor's Degree in a STEM field is required.

- Proficient with one or more programming languages (Java, C++, Python, R, etc.)

- Demonstrated ability to apply data science to solve real-world problems

- Secret Clearance

Preferred Qualifications 

- Familiarity with DoD

- Master’s degree in Operations Research, Industrial Engineering, Applied Mathematics, Statistics, Physics, Computer Science, or related fields. 

- Familiarity with Envision

- Top Secret clearance with SCI eligibility

Salary Range: $97,000 - $233,000

Pay Range

The posted pay range reflects the anticipated base salary range for this position and is provided to give candidates a general understanding of the compensation opportunity. The actual salary offered will be determined based on the requirements of the position and a variety of job-related factors, which may include geographic location, applicable Federal Government contract labor categories and wage rates, relevant experience, skills and competencies, education, certifications, and the scope and responsibilities of the role.

Because this position may be performed in multiple locations and may be subject to different contract requirements, the salary ultimately offered may vary based on the applicable location and contract. The posted range is not a guarantee of a specific starting salary or an indication that an offer will be made at any particular point within the range.

Total Rewards

In addition to competitive base pay, Clarity provides a Total Rewards package designed to attract and retain exceptional professionals committed to excellence. Our benefits reflect the value we place on skilled individuals who drive our impact in critical digital missions.

At Clarity, a career means joining a high-performing team advancing vital work in the digital landscape. We encourage you to consider the total value of joining us—competitive compensation, comprehensive benefits, and resources that support your growth and impact.

Our Total Rewards package includes performance-based bonuses, extensive medical, dental, and vision coverage, a 401(k) plan with company match, substantial paid time off and holidays, flexible work arrangements where possible, and a range of income protection benefits. We are committed to supporting your well-being, professional growth, and ability to contribute to essential digital missions.

We are an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or veteran status.

- Data Locality: Experience managing data persistence across hybrid environments (Public Cloud vs. Private DC).

You believe that "if it isn't monitored, it doesn't exist."

- Instrumentation: Expert-level experience with OpenTelemetry. You don't just look at metrics; you design the telemetry that allows for deep-dive distributed tracing and root-cause analysis.

- Observability Infrastructure: Hands-on experience scaling Prometheus and Grafana to

· Experience with cloud storage S3, NFS, NetApp OnTap, AWS FSX
· Distributed Systems and programming techniques.
· Monitoring and metrics infrastructure (OTEL, Prometheus, Grafana).
· Cloud (AWS / GCP/ Azure / Private DC).
· Bonus: Experience with AI/ML, Natural Language

· Programming languages: GoLang, Java11, Kotlin, Rust, Python

· Container and Orchestration: Kubernetes/Containers (Docker)/Rancher RKE

title: Founding Data Analyst
description:
Our Mission 
Human time and effort is the rarest thing in the universe. The fact that so many people hate what they do for work is a disaster on so many levels. How many people live quiet lives of misery? How many generational talents do we miss due to circumstance?

Dex’s mission is to close the gap between Talent & Opportunity, we believe that work, and being productive, is part of the human condition, that regardless of AI, human passion, ingenuity and a desire to do things means that work will always exist.

We are building Dex to create a future where technology helps every individual to understand their strengths, interests and unique abilities, and to connect with opportunities where they can thrive, because more people doing things they love leads to a better, happier and more productive world.

We are starting by connecting the world's most ambitious software engineers with the companies that deserve them.

The Role

Dex runs on data. Our matching, our product decisions, our growth, our commercial bets all depend on understanding what's actually happening across the business, and right now that intelligence lives in too many places. This is a founding role to own the data foundation of Dex end to end: the data models underneath everything, the pipelines that connect our systems, and the data platform that the whole company (and our agents) builds on top of.

We use agents for a huge amount of our analytical work, which means the quality of our data layer is a force multiplier. Get it right and every person and every agent at Dex gets faster and sharper. You'll own how data is modelled, how it flows between our systems, and how internal teams self-serve on top of it, building on what's already driving the business rather than starting from a blank page.

As the first dedicated data hire, you'll set the standards and build the function out behind you as Dex grows. It's a chance to define how an AI-native company builds on its data from the ground up, in a market with a real dearth of well-built data foundations. We think there's a generational company to be built in this space, and we believe it's going to be Dex.

What You’ll Do

- Core data modelling : Design and own the core data models that everything else depends on, making them clean, trusted and easy to build on.

- Modelling at source : Work inside the product and engineering codebase to ensure data is captured and structured correctly from the start, before it ever reaches the warehouse.

- Pipelines : Build and maintain the pipelines that connect our systems, so data flows through the business correctly and reliably.

- Self-serve platform : Make the data platform genuinely self-serve, so product, growth, commercial and ops teams (and our agents) can answer their own questions without coming to you.

- Agents as consumers : Treat agents as first-class consumers of the data layer, structuring data so they can do analytical work accurately and at scale.

- Metrics that matter : Partner with the team on the metrics that matter, from acquisition and activation through to matching quality and commercial performance.

- Answers, not just queries : Turn ambiguous business questions into the right data model, the right metric and a clear answer.

- Standards : Set the standards for data quality, definitions and instrumentation across Dex.

What we’re looking for

- You've built the data foundation for a consumer product or marketplace before, and you know what good looks like at scale.

- You're an engineer and an analyst. You can model and pipe the data, and read what it's telling you about the business. 

- Comfortable reading existing code and finding your way through a codebase you didn't write. You can pick up how a system models and emits its data, and confidently make changes within it.

- Fluent across a modern analytics stack (a cloud warehouse, a transformation layer, orchestration and BI), with views on what to use when. We're open to changing our current choices and want someone who can tell us where they're right and where they aren't.

- Commercially and product minded. You care about the metric and the decision it drives, not just the query.

- You think about the platform, not the one-off answer. You build things other people (and agents) can stand on.

- Intelligent, ambitious, with strong judgement. A good person who's fun to work with and makes things happen without being asked.

What We Offer 

- Above market salary — we're building a world class team and believe pay should match that ambition

- Significant equity — we want this to be the last job you 'have' to take

- Full private healthcare & dental — because life happens and we want to support you

- Fertility benefits & enhanced parental support

- Gym membership & wellness benefits

- Claude tokens — lots and lots of Claude tokens

- Regular socials, offsites and an annual trip

- MacBook Pro + team kit

- "Whatever you need" approach to tools and support

Interview process 

We move quickly and with conviction. Broadly you can expect:

- We love it when candidates have experimented with our agent, Dex. Even if you aren't an Engineer, you can get a sense of what we're building, and we love to hear your feedback. 

- A 30m video call with our Internal Talent Lead; we'll share more about the team, role and business before asking questions about your experience and fit.

- Hiring Manager call: we'll share more specific context on short and medium-term objectives and ask deeper questions relative to the role requirements.

- Most roles involve a practical task to better understand how you work. Usually completed offline and reviewed by the team.

- Onsite interview loop where you'll visit the office, meet a cohort of the team, one interview centred on the task you produced, another on Dex culture and values, with a final interview with our Founder, Paddy.

The will work on assigned programs with the respective Global Regulatory Portfolio Lead, Global Regulatory Lead and cross-functional team to lead the EU regulatory strategy and facilitate submission of data packages to the EMA. The role is responsible for planning and coordinating all aspects of regulatory submissions necessary to support product development, clinical trials and product registration. The role will represent RA on multidisciplinary product development subteams and Global Regulatory Team. Additional responsibilities include involvement in the writing and oversight of regulatory submissions, coordinating all aspects of paper and electronic regulatory submissions, proactively keeping updated on EU regulatory requirements, and interpreting regulatory intelligence for the internal teams.

- Serve as EU Regional Lead for assigned program (s); additional responsibilities may include serving as as Regulatory Program Lead (leading the Global Regulatory Team), for one of the early programs in the Alnylam pipeline.

Regulatory documents may include the relevant forms, meeting requests, Briefing Documents for HA meetings, new Clinical Trial Applications (CTAs), Marketing Applications, Paediatric Plans, Orphan Designation and Expedited Pathway Applications (e.g. PRIME), and any amendments.

- Serve as member of the Global Regulatory Team, may serve as Regulatory representative in multidisciplinary product subteams or core team for assigned programs and participate as an active team member to provide strategic regulatory advice in relation to EU regulatory activities.

- Coordinate responses to regulatory authorities’ questions with strict adherence to deadlines.

- Serve as a liaison within internal departments at Alnylam, with CROs and with regulatory program managers at HAs.

- Maintain regulatory files in a format consistent with internal requirements.

- Facilitate as necessary the review of technical regulatory documentation and recommend changes to documentation or processes, including SOPs for regulatory compliance.

- Provide EU specific regulatory intelligence to internal stakeholders as appropriate.

Qualifications 

- Bachelor's degree with 6 or more years of experience in a Regulatory Affairs role; minimum of 8 years’ experience working in the biotech or pharmaceutical industry. Higher degree would be a plus.

- Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including negotiation and influencing skills.

- Solid understanding of regulations and experience in interpretation of guidelines.

- Ability to think strategically and to proactively identify issues and mitigation strategies in various aspects of the drug development process.

- Experience with regulatory filings, including electronic submissions, e.g., CTAs, post-marketing variations, safety reporting, paediatric plans, PRIME etc.

- Excellent organizational and project management skills; demonstrated ability to prioritize multiple projects.

- Ability to work in a team environment, possessing interpersonal skills to work effectively with other departments at various levels and with CROs and external consultants.

Based on Nobel Prize-winning science, RNAi therapeutics represent a powerful, clinically validated approach to treating diseases at their genetic source by “interfering” with mRNA that cause or contribute to disease. title: Platform Engineer
description:
About us

We love pets - which is why we're on a mission to make the world a better place for pets and their parents. We offer pet insurance policies with generous pet health benefits that are designed with their needs in mind. We've helped half a million pets stay happy and healthy since 2017 - and many more customers throughout the world are joining us every day. Our company is respectful, fun-loving and passionate about pets and their wellbeing. Throughout our business you'll meet people who think differently, aim for impact, and love to try new things. Want to join our pack? Join us. Love every moment. Love ManyPets.

A day in the life

As a Platform Engineer, you will join our platform squad. We build and maintain the AWS infrastructure, deployment pipelines, tooling and engineering standards that every other squad at ManyPets depends on.

This role has a security focus. Much of your first year will be spent building the tooling that lets us demonstrate our security controls are working: automated compliance checks, reporting, and evidence collection to support our ISO 27001 commitments. Alongside that you will help us tighten access controls across our cloud estate, and take on ownership of the edge and network security tooling that protects our services.

You will also work closely with our Head of Security as we build out a dedicated security capability at ManyPets.

Our environment is fast-paced and highly collaborative. You will work closely with your teammates using pair or mob programming, participating in regular workshops and planning sessions, primarily over Zoom, with occasional in-person collaboration.

We embrace modern development practices:

- All our services are cloud-hosted on AWS, using serverless and event-driven architectures for scalability and resilience.

- We use a fully automated deployment pipeline, allowing you to release to production within minutes, multiple times per day.

- We define our infrastructure as code, and we emphasise observability, testing and secure-by-design principles from the start.

As a squad we own our work end-to-end, including development, maintenance and support. You will play a key role in ensuring the reliability and quality of what we provide to the rest of engineering, and contribute to a culture of rapid learning and continuous improvement.

Your responsibilities

ü Build and maintain secure platform foundations

- Design, build and maintain the shared cloud infrastructure, tooling and deployment pipelines that other squads rely on.

- Define infrastructure as code so our environments are consistent, repeatable and reviewable.

- Make secure configuration the default, so squads get it without having to ask for it.

- Maintain the edge and network security tooling that protects our services.

- Share in the day-to-day operational ownership of the platform, responding to requests and issues raised by other squads.

ü Make our security controls provable

- Build automated checks that continuously test our cloud estate against our security and compliance requirements.

- Automate the collection and reporting of evidence for ISO 27001, replacing manual effort.

- Surface and report on gaps, drift and findings so they can be prioritised and resolved.

- Work with our Head of Security to turn written policy into controls that are enforced by tooling.

ü Strengthen access and identity controls

- Review and tighten access across our cloud accounts, working towards least privilege.

- Improve how we manage secrets, credentials and machine identities.

- Make access changes auditable, and straightforward for engineers to request and for us to review.

ü Extend our platform standards beyond AWS

- Help us apply the standards, tooling and controls we have built in AWS to our Google Cloud estate.

- Work with the teams who use Google Cloud to understand their needs and where the gaps are.

ü Team collaboration

- Work closely with other squad members and stakeholders to align on goals and solutions.

- Support engineers across other squads who use our platform, and take their feedback seriously.

- Proactively build shared understanding across the team through pairing, discussions, and reviews.

- Document your work clearly to support knowledge sharing and future maintenance.

ü Self development

- Take ownership of your learning journey and technical development plan.

- Approach challenges with curiosity and a growth mindset.

- Learn from your peers and actively seek feedback and mentorship.

Your skills and experience

We are looking for someone with:

- Commercial experience building and maintaining cloud infrastructure on a major cloud provider (AWS, Google Cloud or Azure).

- Hands-on experience defining infrastructure as code, using CDK, Terraform or similar.

- Experience building and maintaining continuous integration and deployment pipelines.

- A good working understanding of cloud security fundamentals, including identity and access management, secrets management, network controls and encryption.

- Proficiency in at least one scripting language, ideally Python.

- Comfort working in a regulated environment. We are FCA regulated and take our ISO 27001 commitments seriously.

We would also like to see at least one of the following. You do not need both, and we will support you to build the other:

- A security specialism, such as cloud security posture management, security tooling, threat modelling or compliance automation.

- Experience across more than one cloud provider, ideally both AWS and Google Cloud.

The interview process

This position has a four-stage interview process, which will be held via Zoom.

- Stage 1 - an initial conversation with a member of our Talent team.

- Stage 2 - an informal meeting with the hiring manager for about 45 minutes. We will explain more about the role and explore how your experience matches up with what we need.

- Stage 3 - a longer interview, up to an hour, with the hiring manager and two engineers from the team. We will ask some competency questions and work through a technical scenario together. There is no take-home exercise.

- Stage 4 - an informal conversation with our Head of Security.

About the team

The EPD ("Engineering, Product and Design") team operates with a squad system and Agile ways of working within quarterly terms - and we really enjoy working collaboratively. We hold regular 'Hack Weeks' to look at products and address problems relating to the business, and we get the chance to highlight and work on things we're interested in and feel passionately about.

Our tech stack

We are on a mission to become the best we can be, constantly challenging ourselves to achieve and learn. You will be supported to learn new technology – both in breadth and depth - and encouraged to challenge our ways of thinking with new and innovative ideas.

Our "north star" is to become an elite performer as defined by the 4 key DORA metrics. To drive towards elite status, we apply and continually inspect and adapt the best Agile frameworks and practices inspired by DevOps, SRE, Scrum, XP and Lean. We are a highly collaborative environment and regularly practice Mob and Pair based programming which we believe improve our quality of delivery and share understanding.

We take our operational performance, security, and reliability as seriously as our quality and development practices. We are cloud hosted and highly automated, primarily on AWS with some critical services running on Google Cloud.

Some specific technologies we use include: AWS | Google Cloud | Python | CDK | GitHub Actions | MongoDB | Aikido | Cloudflare

Salary range:

£55,000 — £65,000 GBP 

Ways of working

On a typical day you'll be working from a laptop with a screen, mouse, keyboard, and headset. You'll be meeting your colleagues on Zoom and keeping in touch regularly via email and Slack too – we'd expect you to be using your computer for around seven hours a day. We'd ask that you have a distraction-free work area and a reliable internet connection with a speed of 25Mbps so you can work effectively. We'll make sure you have the right home set-up that supports you in the role by providing best-in-class technology, money towards a desk, and vision support.

Inclusion at ManyPets

We promise to give you the same opportunities as everyone else and we won't discriminate against you at any point in the process. This includes how we source talent, our interview process, our conditions of employment (including pay) and feedback. title: Delivery Manager Genflex
description:
Help us use technology to make a big green dent in the universe!

Kraken powers some of the most innovative global developments in energy.

We create the technology that redefines utilities and unlocks a new energy system of the future. By optimising renewable generation, building a more intelligent grid, and empowering utilities to deliver an exceptional customer experience, our operating system is transforming the industry worldwide.

It’s an incredibly exciting time to work in energy. Join us on our mission to improve the lives of ONE BILLION humans within the decade and shape a cleaner, better future for everyone.

🐙 Kraken Generation Flex

The energy industry is undergoing the largest transformation since industrialisation at an unprecedented rate of change and we are positioning ourselves to be at the heart of that change.

Our aim is to be the leading global provider of solutions that enable customers to release £30bn of value per annum from distributed energy resources (DERs). We are building a Software as a Service (SaaS) subscription business with a global addressable market of £2.4 billion per annum, by digitally connecting hundreds of thousands of DERs with energy markets.

We have already attained a market leading position and Kraken is a recognised thought leader and innovator in the industry.

🏠 Where you’ll fit in and role summary

As we enter a stage of rapid commercialisation and growth, we're looking for a Generation Flex Delivery Manager to own the successful onboarding of flexible generation and energy assets onto KrakenFlex across the EU.

This is a customer-facing delivery role with a strong technical bias. You'll manage an asset through the full onboarding journey, from initial discovery and technical analysis, through site design and gateway installation, to commissioning, testing and handover into live service.

You'll sit at the intersection of our customers, Electrical Engineering, Product and Customer Success Engineering teams. You'll need to understand both the connectivity and control architecture of our customers' assets and how those assets connect to and operate through the KrakenFlex SaaS platform .

You won't be expected to design the details of the integration solution or write the software yourself. Instead, you'll need enough technical depth across both areas to understand how they fit together, identify gaps and risks, challenge incomplete information and drive the right conversations to get a site successfully integrated.

Your role is to bring together three perspectives throughout onboarding:

Customer : What is the customer trying to achieve, and what do we need from them?

Product : How will the asset operate within KrakenFlex, and what product capabilities and configuration are required?

Engineering : How does the physical asset need to be integrated, connected and commissioned to make that solution work?

Your job is to make sure those three come together as one successfully delivered customer solution .

🚀 What you'll own

- Own the end-to-end onboarding and delivery of Generation Flex assets BESS (grid-scale and C&I) and RES (Wind and Solar), from initial onboarding through analysis, site design, installation, configuration, commissioning, testing and handover into live service.

- Build a strong understanding of the Generation Flex product and SaaS platform , including how assets are represented, configured, monitored and controlled within KrakenFlex.

- Understand how the physical site and its electrical/control systems connect into the KrakenFlex software architecture, and bring those two worlds together throughout onboarding.

- Work closely with Product and Software Engineering teams to understand the relevant GenFlex capabilities, product modules, configuration requirements and technical constraints for each customer and asset.

- Translate between customer requirements, electrical engineering requirements and SaaS/product requirements , making sure each group understands what is needed from the others.

- Understand the end-to-end data and control path from the physical asset through site controls, meters, PPCs, gateways and communications infrastructure into Kraken Flex, and from Kraken Flex back to the asset where control is required.

- Ensure that the customer's intended use of the GenFlex product is reflected in the technical onboarding solution, including the required telemetry, controls, configuration, integrations and product modules.

- Be able to explain to customers how their site will interact with KrakenFlex, both from a physical integration perspective and from a software/product perspective.

- Work with Product teams to identify where customer or asset requirements do not fit current product capabilities, and ensure gaps, constraints or product dependencies are surfaced early.

- Feed recurring onboarding challenges, customer requirements and technical integration pain points back into Product and Engineering teams to help improve and scale the GenFlex proposition.

- Be the primary delivery point of contact for customers during site onboarding, setting clear expectations around what we need from them, what Kraken is delivering and what needs to happen next.

- Work closely with our Electrical Engineering and Customer Success Engineering teams to ensure the technical information required to integrate a site is complete, accurate and available at the right stage of delivery.

- Review and interpret customer technical documentation including:

- Electrical Single Line Diagrams (SLDs)

- Network and communications diagrams

- Site and asset specifications

- PPC and controller documentation

- Modbus register maps

- IP addressing and network information

- Functional Design Specifications

- Metering and telemetry information

- Hardware and connectivity requirements

- Be confident discussing technical site architecture with customers and engineers, understanding how equipment such as generators, batteries, meters, PPCs, controllers, gateways and site networks fit together.

- Identify missing, inconsistent or technically unclear customer information early and drive it to resolution before it becomes a delivery blocker.

- Coordinate the preparation and review of Kraken integration documentation, including gateway architecture, communications diagrams, Kraken SLDs, integration designs and site configuration information.

- Coordinate the Kraken Gateway delivery and installation process , ensuring prerequisites such as power, networking, connectivity and installation arrangements are understood and ready.

- Manage readiness for key commissioning and testing activities, including:

- Gateway installation and connectivity

- Operational acceptance testing

- Kraken market and service testing

- Proactively manage delivery risks and communicate issues and mitigation plans clearly to internal and external stakeholders.

- Surface blockers early and drive the right people together to resolve them rather than allowing issues to sit between teams.

- Maintain clear visibility of the status and health of each site, including technical readiness, product readiness, customer actions, Kraken actions and upcoming milestones.

- Continuously improve the Generation Flex onboarding process, identifying recurring technical, product or customer blockers and working with Engineering, Product and Operations teams to remove them.

🧠 What you'll bring to the party

- A strong technical background and the confidence to work closely with electrical, control systems, and networking.

- The ability to read and understand an Electrical Single Line Diagram (SLD) and use it to understand the electrical architecture of a site.

- A practical understanding of industrial networking and communications , including concepts such as IP addressing, LANs, routers, switches, VPNs and site connectivity.

- Enough electrical engineering knowledge to understand concepts such as metering, breakers, transformers, generators, inverters, batteries and asset control systems.

- Experience delivering technical projects involving the integration, commissioning or onboarding of physical assets, ideally within energy, renewables, utilities, industrial automation, controls or a similar environment.

- Excellent communication skills , with the ability to take a complicated technical problem and clearly explain the issue, impact, owner and next action.

- Experience coordinating multiple teams and dependencies across customers, Electrical Engineering, hardware, installation partners and other third parties.

- A highly organised approach to delivery, with strong attention to detail and the ability to manage multiple sites at different stages of onboarding simultaneously.

- The ability to proactively identify risk, remove blockers and maintain momentum in an environment where customer readiness and site timelines can change quickly.

- A customer-centric mindset and a drive to provide an outstanding onboarding experience without compromising technical quality.

- A pragmatic, collaborative approach and the confidence to operate in a fast-moving environment where processes and products are still evolving.

- A strong interest in understanding how a SaaS product works end-to-end , rather than treating the software platform as a black box.

- A drive to get things done in a collaborative, agile environment , comfortable navigating the complexity and comfortable being the regional face of site onboarding function.

- Language: professional fluency in English . A second European language would be preferable.

⭐️ Bonus points

- Experience in APIs, data flows, system integrations or cloud software architecture would be beneficial.

- Experience in flexible generation, battery storage, renewable energy, demand response or distributed energy resources.

- A working understanding of industrial communication protocols and controlled environments would be helpful (e.g. modbus, OPC UA )

- Experience commissioning or integrating generators, BESS, solar, EV infrastructure or other industrial energy assets.

- Previous experience working with grid-connected assets, control systems or energy market services.

- Experience with SaaS implementation, technical product onboarding or systems integration.

- Familiarity with commissioning processes and the distinction between cold commissioning, energisation and hot commissioning.

- Experience with industrial gateways, edge devices or IoT connectivity.

title: Field Event Manager, EMEA
description:

We raised a $250M Series C to build the search engine for AIs. Led by a16z, with existing investors Benchmark, Lightspeed, and YC doubling down, the round brings Exa's valuation to $2.2 billion. 

Exa is building a search engine for the AI era. Our Search API currently powers Agents, Fortune 500s and AI labs as we transform an industry that hasn't been disrupted since the 90s. We're a largely SF-based team of ~100 from Harvard, MIT, Meta, Google Research, ex-founders & dropouts alike.

We are rapidly building the most intelligent search engine in history. We're high agency, low-ego, and united by the feeling that this is one of the last problems worth getting right.

We are looking for a Field Event Manager based in London to build our presence across EMEA.

About the Role 

Exa is expanding to the EU and the UK and we are looking for an ambitious, proactive, and collaborative Field Marketer to partner closely with our regional team and build demand in this critical market. Companies big and small are making critical decisions about how to invest in AI and how their AI agents will retrieve information, and you will play a key role in how they discover Exa. As the first Field Marketer in EMEA, you will shape how buyers experience our brand and interact with our team, through highly strategic, and thoughtfully crafted events.

This is one of those rare, founding team member opportunities: you'll build the regional program from the ground up and inform so much beyond our event strategy; from messaging and overall brand presence at a pivotal time for Exa. This is an incredible fit for someone who sweats the details, lives to create world-class experiences, and obsesses over how to drive pipeline from every touchpoint. You will own the regional program, identify opportunities to build brand awareness and pipeline through a mix of high-hospitality and lead generating events including: executive dinners, networking receptions, hackathons, third-party sponsorships, partner events, and more. You'll partner strategically with Account Executives and SDRs to build an event plan that delivers coverage across your territory and key accounts.

Our bar is high and our north star is to establish Exa as a world-class brand. We’re a team that embraces learnings as opportunities to optimize future events and processes, while remaining focused on our pursuit to drive ever increasing pipeline. If this sounds exciting to you, we'd love to meet you!

This role is based in person in London, with regular travel across the EMEA and the occasional trip to our San Francisco HQ.

What You Will Own

Regional program strategy. Own the plan for your territory, deciding which formats, cities, audiences, and investments will meet our pipeline goals each quarter. Co-build the plan with input from sales and defend it with pipeline rationale. Success is measured by program quality and by pipeline sourced and influenced in the region.

End-to-end execution. Own every event from concept to post-event follow-up: sourcing venues, orchestrating vendors and production, managing invitations and the run of show, overseeing on-site execution, and sweating every detail. Success is measured by the number of qualified attendees and by nailing execution.

Sales partnership and account targeting alignment. Establish and maintain tight sales partnerships, align with sales to get the right personas and accounts to each event and create effective event playbooks that convert to pipeline. Success is measured by meetings generated and by the number of target accounts engaged through your programs.

Pipeline outcomes and follow-through. Own what happens during and after the event: ensuring timely lead handoff and building the follow-up sequence in partnership with SDRs, Lifecycle Marketing, and Marketing Ops. Success is measured by conversion from attendee to qualified opportunity.

Budget and vendors. Own your regional budget, vendor selection and negotiation, and cost per qualified lead. Success is measured by program impact per dollar.

AI-first operations. Use AI to compress operational timelines: invite-list development, personalized outreach at scale, vendor research, run-of-show generation, and post-event summarization. You'll run a serious regional program because the busywork is automated.

Who You Are

- 4+ years of experience in field marketing or event marketing at a B2B technology company, including ownership of a regional program rather than execution of someone else's.

- Deeply committed to event craft: You can walk us through a run of show, tell us what you check at 4pm before a 6pm start, and describe the last thing that went wrong at an event and how you fixed it.

- Demonstrated ability to drive pipeline: You have owned a pipeline number and can speak to cost per qualified lead.

- Evidence of strong sales partnership: You can speak to how you've built strong partnerships with sales counterparts in similar roles, including how you manage reps who push for something you know isn't the right investment.

- Deep understanding of the EMEA market: You have a finger on the pulse of the cultural nuances, best venues, vendors, and event tactics that will draw an audience of senior technical buyers here.

- Meticulous event budget and timeline management: You have both budget and vendor negotiation experience.

- Upholds a growth mindset: You embrace feedback as a lever to fuel growth and see learnings as an opportunity to optimize for next time.

- Experience using AI to drive efficiencies: You use AI daily to remove operational load, and can show us how.

Nice to Have

- Experience running events for a technical or developer audience alongside enterprise buyers.

- Experience at an early-stage company where you built the program rather than inherited it.

- Experience developing booth designs and strategies that drive lead generation.

- Familiarity with event tech (registration, badge scanning, on-site capture) and how it connects to CRM.

- Experience crafting executive roundtables or advisory dinners for senior technical leaders.

- Experience building reports to track event performance.

Benefits 

- Health and wellness: Premium medical coverage, plus a monthly wellness benefit tiered by location.

- Fertility and family planning: Reimbursement for eligible egg freezing and related medical expenses up to a $15,000 lifetime maximum, plus 16 weeks of fully paid parental leave for all new parents, whether through birth, adoption, surrogacy, or foster placement.

- Life at Exa: Our SF office serves lunch and dinner daily, with snacks, coffee, fresh bread from a local bakery, weekly milk tea, monthly picnics, and parties to celebrate the wins (and each other). You'll visit often.

title: Expert Assurance | Courtage & IA @Panora (backed by Hexa)
description:
À propos de Panora

Panora est une plateforme d'IA native pour les courtiers en assurance. Nos agents IA automatisent les workflows à forte friction, cotation, comparaison de contrats, analyse des garanties, vérification de conformité, génération de documents et produisent des résultats structurés et actionnables en quelques minutes plutôt qu'en heures.

Nous accompagnons les cabinets de courtage en France et en Belgique, avec une conviction claire : le courtage en assurance est opérationnellement dysfonctionnel depuis des décennies, et l'IA est enfin le bon outil pour y remédier. L'IA n'est plus optionnelle pour les courtiers : elle devient le standard. La question n'est plus si , mais à quel point elle est bien mise en œuvre.

Panora a été fondée par Diane et Fabian. Diane a passé plusieurs années en capital-risque avec une solide expérience opérationnelle et connaît de l'intérieur les défis du scaling de business complexes. Fabian est un fondateur multi-récidiviste et ingénieur IA orienté produit, pionnier dans la construction de systèmes IA qui fonctionnent vraiment en production. Ensemble, ils ont décidé de créer Panora pour transformer les opérations d'assurance en avantage concurrentiel en temps réel pour les courtiers.

Panora est soutenue par Hexa (anciennement eFounders), le studio de startups pionnier en Europe, qui a lancé plus de 35 entreprises dont des licornes comme Front, Aircall et Spendesk.

Pourquoi ce rôle existe

Nous avons construit une IA qui lit des contrats, compare des garanties et génère des analyses de couverture à grande échelle. La technologie fonctionne. Nous avons maintenant besoin de quelqu'un qui la rende brillante : quelqu'un d'assez méticuleux pour détecter chaque lacune, d'assez expérimenté pour savoir ce qui compte vraiment dans une police, et d'assez curieux pour vouloir façonner l'IA de l'intérieur.

Vous serez le cerveau assurance de Panora, la personne qui examine ce que notre IA produit, vérifie chaque synthèse, et réinjecte son expertise dans le système pour qu'il s'améliore en continu. C'est une opportunité unique de vivre la transformation par l'IA de l'intérieur et de participer activement à la construction du futur du courtage.

Vos responsabilités

- Vérification des outputs IA, contrat par contrat. Vous examinez les synthèses, analyses de couverture et recommandations générées par notre IA. Vous vérifiez leur exactitude, corrigez les erreurs et garantissez que chaque output répond au niveau d'exigence qu'un courtier engagerait sa réputation à défendre. Votre œil méticuleux est la dernière ligne de défense avant que les outputs n'atteignent les clients.

- La boucle de feedback qui rend notre IA plus intelligente. Vous identifiez les schémas dans ce que l'IA réussit et rate. Vous travaillez avec les équipes produit et engineering pour réinjecter votre expertise assurance dans le système — améliorer les prompts, affiner le raisonnement, encoder les nuances que seules des années d'expérience permettent de saisir.

- Accompagnement client et confiance. Vous soutenez l'onboarding des clients et leur usage au quotidien, en aidant les courtiers à comprendre et faire confiance aux outputs de l'IA. Quand des questions surgissent, vous apportez la crédibilité et l'expertise nécessaires pour expliquer, rassurer ou corriger.

- Expertise assurance en IARD et Santé. Vous apportez une expertise approfondie en assurance dommages (IARD) et en assurance santé : les deux piliers de notre produit actuel. Vous en maîtrisez les spécificités et garantissez que notre IA traite les deux avec précision.

Votre profil

- Expérience en tant que courtier, souscripteur, ou dans un rôle d'analyse technique des couvertures

- Expertise approfondie en IARD et/ou santé : vous connaissez ces produits sur le bout des doigts

- Méticuleux de nature : vous êtes la personne qui repère l'exclusion enfouie page 47

- Vous lisez un contrat et identifiez immédiatement ce qui compte, ce qui manque, et ce qui pourrait nuire à un client

- Vous écrivez clairement et savez expliquer des concepts complexes d'assurance à des non-experts

- Vous êtes sincèrement curieux de ce que l'IA change pour notre secteur, enthousiaste à l'idée de le vivre de l'intérieur et d'y contribuer

- Vous êtes à l'aise dans l'ambiguïté et attachez plus d'importance au métier de l'assurance qu'au confort de la routine

- Français courant ; l'anglais est un plus

Ce rôle est fait pour vous si

- Vous avez passé des années à maîtriser l'assurance et souhaitez encoder cette expertise dans un produit qui transforme l'industrie

- L'idée de vivre la transformation par l'IA de l'intérieur vous enthousiasme, pas seulement utiliser des outils, mais les construire

- Vous êtes méticuleux, rigoureux, et mettez un point d'honneur à bien faire les choses

- Vous aimez accompagner les clients et les aider à réussir

title: Product Owner – Trust Services (eIDAS2, EUDI Wallet & Trust Platform) (f/m/d)
description:
IDnow is a leader in digital identity and fraud prevention in Europe with a mission to transform trust into the most powerful asset in the digital world, empowering enterprises with AI-driven, SaaS-based identity solutions that deliver scalable security, adaptive compliance, and real-time fraud prevention . Through its broad portfolio of digital identity and fraud prevention solutions, IDnow establishes, maintains and enriches trust throughout the customer journey, ensuring businesses can confidently and securely operate while leveraging digital identity to drive growth, security and scalability. 

The company has offices in Germany, United Kingdom, Romania and France , and is backed by renowned institutional investors, including Corsair Capital and Seventure Partners. Its portfolio of international clients spans a wide range of end markets including financial services, telecommunications, travel & mobility, gaming, and other industries. 

This position is based in Berlin/Munich, Germany or Rennes, France. 

IDnow is looking for Product Owner – Trust Services (f/m/d) to own the product direction, backlog and outcomes for a technical product area within IDnow’s Digital Identity and Trust Services portfolio. Working with a dedicated Scrum Team, this role turns customer, operational, regulatory and engineering input into a clear product goal, an ordered backlog and valuable, usable increments that can be released and operated safely. 

The most critical aspect of this role is serving as the accountable product interface between the Trust Services domain and Engineering: understanding the system boundaries, APIs, integrations, data flows and non-functional requirements well enough to make sound trade-offs, remove ambiguity and ensure that security, privacy, resilience, auditability and regulatory obligations are built into the product from the beginning. 

Key Responsibilities 

- Own the product goal, roadmap and backlog : prioritize by value, risk, dependencies and learning; keep decisions transparent. 

- Drive Scrum outcomes : lead refinement, support Planning and Reviews, clarify Sprint Goals, and use delivery metrics to improve flow. 

- Turn needs into buildable requirements : define user/system journeys, domain concepts, business rules, APIs, data states, errors, acceptance criteria and testable non-functional requirements – without over-prescribing implementation. 

- Partner on solution quality : work with Engineering, Architecture, Security, QA and Operations on service boundaries, technical debt, scalability, performance, availability, resilience, observability, incidents and operational readiness. 

- Own data, integration and lifecycle design : govern identity and audit-data flows, access, protection and retention; shape secure, interoperable APIs, including authentication, encryption, versioning, error handling and documentation. 

- Support releases and continuous improvement : define readiness, migrations, cutovers, deprecation, feature flags and rollback; participate in incident reviews and prioritize recurring quality, security and operational issues. 

- Translate regulation into product decisions : apply eIDAS2, EUDI Wallet, QES, QEAA/EAA, identity-proofing and trust-service requirements with Compliance, Legal, Risk and Trust Services SMEs, tracking adoption, reliability, quality, delivery flow and compliance readiness. 

- Collaborate across functions: align with Scrum Team s , Engineering leadership, Architecture, Security, SRE/Operations, Trust Services, Product, Compliance/Legal/Risk/Data Protection, Commercial and Customer Success, as well as relevant partners, relying parties and standards bodies. 

Preferred Experience 

- 4+ years of experience in Product Ownership, Technical Product Management, Business Analysis or similar roles in software and service delivery, including direct responsibility for backlog quality and product outcomes. 

- Hands-on experience working in Scrum or a comparable agile delivery model: ability to define a Product Goal, order a Product Backlog, write clear product backlog items, set acceptance criteria, participate in refinement and reviews, and make timely scope and priority decisions. 

- Strong technical fluency in modern software products and integrations, including REST APIs, JSON/Open API, authentication and authorization, OAuth2/OIDC concepts, webhooks or event streams, data models, service boundaries, API lifecycle and backward-compatible change. 

- Demonstrable experience working with regulated software and services, translating regulatory, security, privacy and audit requirements into actionable product requirements and delivery decisions, while balancing compliance, customer value, usability, scalability and time to market. 

- Practical understanding of secure software and service delivery: threat and risk thinking, software security, access control, encryption, secrets and key management, vulnerability handling, logging/monitoring, incident response, resilience and software supply-chain considerations.
