- Collaborate cross-functionally: Work shoulder-to-shoulder with firmware and software teams on board bring-up, microcontroller integration, and system-level debugging.

- Manage DFM/DFT and supplier relationships: Work directly with contract manufacturers and in-house assembly teams to oversee BOM costs, component sourcing, and engineering change control.

We're looking for someone who has: 

- Completed vocational training or a degree in Electrical Engineering, Robotics, Mechatronics, or a comparable field.

- Several years of experience in full-cycle electrical design (analog, digital, and power circuits) across multiple companies, taking products from concept to market.

- Deep technical background in Altium, multi-layer PCB layout, microcontrollers (ARM Cortex, STM32), motion systems (24/48V power, motor drives, encoders, sensor interfaces), and EMC/thermal layout strategies.

- Solid grasp of DFM/DFT principles, cable harness design, signal integrity, and direct collaboration with contract manufacturers.

- Proactive, end-to-end ownership mindset with a pragmatic working style and a drive to establish scalable processes in a high-growth environment.

- Very good English skills (German is a plus).

- Nice to have: Familiarity with industrial protocols (EtherCAT, Profinet, Modbus, CAN, Ethernet) and exposure to relevant standards/safety concepts (CE/Machinery Directive, ISO 10218, EMC standards, STO, PL/SIL).

Why join RobCo? 

- Develop modular, software-defined robotics solutions with us that set new standards in automation.

- Help us build robots equipped with state-of-the-art AI that perceive their environment, analyze data, and make intelligent decisions in real time.

- As part of a very dynamic and fast-growing scale-up, you will take on responsibility from day one, drive your own projects, and see the direct impact of your work.

- Flat hierarchies, open communication, and regular 360° feedback enable fast decisions and support your professional and personal development.

- Wellpass membership (7,200+ studios across Germany), regular team events, and a team that takes both the work and the culture seriously.

- Flexible working hours, a modern office, and—depending on the role—the option to work from home.

- Regular team events—from relaxed beer & pizza nights on the rooftop terrace to shared experiences on ski trips or at Oktoberfest.

About RobCo 

Founded in Munich in 2020, RobCo leads the transition toward fully Autonomous Industrial Robotics. Our mission is to deploy RobCo in every factory - solving the industrial labor shortage through end-to-end robotics that just works. Powered by Physical AI, our solutions combine a scalable modular hardware architecture with intelligent software that adapts to your use case, improves over time, and requires zero upfront investment through our Robotics-as-a-Service (RaaS) model.

We solve our customers' most pressing pain points - labor shortage, cost pressure, workplace safety, and national reshoring - across the full spectrum of Autonomous Industrial Robotics. With $160M raised from investors including Lightspeed, Lingotto Innovation, and Sequoia, 200+ people globally, and 2.5M+ operating hours in the field, we are deploying robots in factories across Europe and the United States - with our US operations headquartered in Austin, TX, and our RobCo Bay Area Demo Lab in San Francisco.

Don’t meet every single requirement? If you’re excited about this role but your past experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles.

title: Senior Mechanical Engineer - Robotics (m/f/d)
description:
About the Role at RobCo 

RobCo is building the category of Autonomous Industrial Robotics and we're doing it fast. We believe that automating the ordinary frees humans to do the extraordinary, and we're building the end-to-end robotics infrastructure to make that possible - hardware, software, and AI in one stack that just works. 

As our Senior Mechanical Engineer - Robotics (m/f/d), you act as a mechanical engineering powerhouse and technical pillar within our hardware team. You lead end-to-end physical design, drive robust engineering standards, and shape dynamic processes tailored for a fast-paced scale-up environment. As a pragmatic all-rounder and role model, you translate high-level mechanical concepts into field-ready robotic systems that redefine industrial automation.

Your Responsibilities 

- Lead end-to-end mechanical design cycles, taking complex mechanical systems from initial sketching, calculations, and conceptualization through to CAD modeling, prototyping, and full production delivery.

- Establish and refine engineering standards and scalable mechanical design processes suitable for a fast-growing scale-up, ensuring high quality and rapid iteration cycles.

- Act as a technical role model and mentor for junior and peer engineers in adopting modern mechanical standards, design methodologies, and robust documentation practices.

- Design high-precision mechanisms, seamlessly integrating motion systems, actuators, and electrical/mechatronic components into modular hardware architectures.

- Drive DFM/DFT best practices, collaborating directly with contract manufacturers and internal assembly teams to optimize BOM costs, sourcing strategies, and engineering change control (ECO).

- Execute detailed structural calculations, engineering drawings, and geometric dimensioning & tolerancing (GD&T) to guarantee reliable field performance.

- Run projects end to end, planning them out, budgeting, and keeping timelines.

- Collaborate cross-functionally with electronics, software, and physical AI engineering teams to validate physical hardware against real-world operational constraints.

- Proactively identify operational bottlenecks and establish dynamic hardware development processes on the fly to accelerate our time-to-market.

We're looking for someone who has: 

- Completed vocational training or a degree in Mechanical Engineering, Mechatronics, Systems Engineering, or comparable experience.

- Several years of hands-on experience in full-cycle product development and mechanical engineering across multiple companies (not exclusively early-stage startups).

- Deep proficiency in CAD software, preferably SolidWorks, alongside advanced skills in technical drawing creation and engineering calculations.

- Proven experience designing around motion control systems, actuators, sensors, and electrical/mechatronic hardware integration.

- Hands-on DFM/DFT expertise and a track record of working directly with contract manufacturers, managing BOM costs, component sourcing, and change control processes.

- Culture-aligned mindset: Proactive, high ownership mentality, pragmatic working style, and the desire to serve as a supportive role model to the broader engineering team.

- Very good English skills (German is a plus).

- Nice to have: Direct experience in robotics, industrial automation, or kinematic arm design.

Why join RobCo? 

- Develop modular, software-defined robotics solutions with us that set new standards in automation.

- Help us build robots equipped with state-of-the-art AI that perceive their environment, analyze data, and make intelligent decisions in real time.

- As part of a very dynamic and fast-growing scale-up, you will take on responsibility from day one, drive your own projects, and see the direct impact of your work.

- Flat hierarchies, open communication, and regular 360° feedback enable fast decisions and support your professional and personal development.

- Wellpass membership (7,200+ studios across Germany), regular team events, and a team that takes both the work and the culture seriously.

- Flexible working hours, a modern office, and—depending on the role—the option to work from home.

- Regular team events—from relaxed beer & pizza nights on the rooftop terrace to shared experiences on ski trips or at Oktoberfest.

About RobCo 

Founded in Munich in 2020, RobCo leads the transition toward fully Autonomous Industrial Robotics. Our mission is to deploy RobCo in every factory - solving the industrial labor shortage through end-to-end robotics that just works. Powered by Physical AI, our solutions combine a scalable modular hardware architecture with intelligent software that adapts to your use case, improves over time, and requires zero upfront investment through our Robotics-as-a-Service (RaaS) model.

We solve our customers' most pressing pain points - labor shortage, cost pressure, workplace safety, and national reshoring - across the full spectrum of Autonomous Industrial Robotics. With $160M raised from investors including Lightspeed, Lingotto Innovation, and Sequoia, 200+ people globally, and 2.5M+ operating hours in the field, we are deploying robots in factories across Europe and the United States - with our US operations headquartered in Austin, TX, and our RobCo Bay Area Demo Lab in San Francisco.

Don’t meet every single requirement? If you’re excited about this role but your past experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles. 

At RobCo, applicants are selected regardless of ethnic origin, religion, gender, age, disability, or sexual orientation. All decisions throughout the recruitment process are based solely on applicants’ qualifications, skills, knowledge, and experience, as well as relevant business requirements.

title: Principal Program Manager (f/m/x)
description:
About lemon.markets 🍋

We enable anyone to be an investor. Our mission is to grow investing opportunities for all European customers and businesses. By empowering FinTechs, banks, and wealth managers to offer investment products, we help create financial well-being for their customers.

lemon.markets is a Brokerage-as-a-Service platform: simple digital access to capital markets through a single API. Our API-first infrastructure abstracts brokerage complexity with a well-documented API, a self-service customer operations portal, and a clear regulatory framework, so partners can launch customer-centric, compliant products in weeks, not months.

As part of the dwpbank Group, we share a clear goal: making investing in capital markets more accessible. By combining dwpbank’s long-standing expertise and stability with lemon.markets’ technology-first mindset and speed, we are building a modern, modular securities services ecosystem. Together, we offer faster time-to-market, modular services, and a modern customer experience that helps financial service providers stay competitive and respond more flexibly in a changing market.

Your Mission 
As we deepen our collaboration with our parent company, dwpbank, we are looking for a highly strategic and execution-focused person to lead one of our most important cross-company initiatives.

In this role, you will act as the central coordination point for a joint offering with dwpbank. You will bring clarity to complexity, align stakeholders across both organizations, and drive the overall program across commercial, product, and governance workstreams. Your job is to ensure that the right topics move forward, dependencies are surfaced early, and teams stay focused on what matters most.

In this role you will: 

- Own the overall coordination of a critical cross-company strategic program between lemon.markets and dwpbank.

- Help shape how lemon.markets’ and dwpbank’s offerings come together into a compelling joint proposition for shared customers.

- Collaborate closely with product, engineering, operations, legal, and commercial stakeholders to ensure seamless execution across the full value chain.

- Act as the connective layer across teams and senior stakeholders, ensuring that priorities, decisions, risks, and dependencies are transparent and actively managed.

- Work closely with senior leaders at lemon.markets and dwpbank to keep the program on track and escalate where needed.

- Identify strategic risks and opportunities early, connect the dots across domains, and proactively steer the program accordingly.

- Translate complex discussions and developments into clear recommendations, concrete next steps, and actionable decisions.

- Keep momentum high across all involved stakeholders by driving follow-through, enabling effective communication across teams, building bridges between organizations and functions, and ensuring lemoneers and leadership have the right information and context at the right time.

- Partner with internal commercial teams and dwpbank counterparts to support business development efforts for the joint offering.

You’ll be successful in this role if you: 

- Bring strong experience in program management, strategic project leadership, or change delivery in a complex financial-services environment.

- Have experience in securities services, custody, brokerage, wealth management, asset management, or adjacent financial infrastructure environments.

- Understand how to navigate regulated environments and cross-functional dependencies across multiple senior stakeholders.

- Are able to absorb complex context quickly, structure ambiguity, and turn it into practical action.

- Are not just a status-tracker: you bring judgment, anticipate what matters, and actively steer topics before they become problems.

- Combine strategic thinking with a hands-on mindset, strong execution discipline, and a clear drive to make progress.

- Are a patient, thoughtful communicator who can build trust, create alignment, and move topics forward across organizational boundaries and seniority levels.

- Know how to facilitate communication across diverse stakeholder groups, ensure the right context is shared with the right people, and help teams stay aligned even in complex or sensitive situations.

- Have strong commercial instincts and understand how product, execution, and business development interact in strategic initiatives.

- Are fluent in German and English.

How we take care of you: 

- 🚀 Compensation package: We offer you a competitive salary, based on your experience and the value-add you bring to lemon.markets.

- 🕑 Flexible working hours: We trust people to choose when they work best and avoid a rigid 9 to 5 mindset. You decide on the rhythm that helps you do your best work, with only shared core hours from 12:00 to 16:00 to support collaboration.

- 🏢 Hybrid work setup: You can work from anywhere in Germany within a hybrid model. At the same time, in-person collaboration is a key part of our culture. That being said, individual contributer lemoneers work 4 days or more per month on-site in our Berlin office, spending quality time together with the team at events, onsites/offsites or over team dinners.

- 📈 Grow with us: We take your personal development seriously! You’ll get regular mentorship and stretch opportunities, a clear career development framework with frequent feedback conversations as well as an annual learning budget.

- 🌱 People & culture : You’ll feel our culture in the small things, like polaroids from our lemoneers’ first day, Friday food market strolls at Maybachufer, and our monthly new-joiner breakfast. But also in the bigger things: celebrating the onboarding of new partners, growing our teams, and owning a strong discussion culture.

- 💛 Perks & benefits: We choose benefits that add actual value. We sponsor a Deutschlandticket for employees on unlimited contracts, plus 50% off on Beatvest - our partner for financial education and investing.

- 🏝 Workation: Get out of here! At lemon.markets you can work remotely from anywhere in the EU for up to 10 consecutive days at a time, and up to 60 days per year in total.

As an equal opportunity employer, lemon.markets is committed to building an inclusive workplace. The company welcomes people from all different backgrounds, including age, citizenship, ethnic and racial origins, gender identities, individuals with disabilities, marital status, religions and ideologies, and sexual orientations to apply.

If you feel this role could be a great match for you even if you don’t tick every box, we’d still love to hear from you, please apply.

title: Head of Finance & Data (m/w/d)
description:
Deine Aufgaben Zahlen sind deine Leidenschaft, und du willst die Datenbasis dahinter nicht nur nutzen, sondern selbst gestalten? Dann bist du bei uns genau richtig. Als Head of Finance & Data (m/w/d) bist du das strategische und technische Fundament für unser weiteres Wachstum.

In dieser vielseitigen Doppelrolle verbindest du messerscharfe Zahlenkompetenz mit einem echten Gespür für Datenarchitektur und Reporting-Infrastruktur. Du baust nicht nur ein stabiles Controlling auf, sondern gestaltest parallel die technische Grundlage, auf der unser gesamtes Unternehmen datenbasierte Entscheidungen trifft. Kurz: Du hältst uns den Rücken frei und lenkst aktiv unseren Erfolgskurs mit.

- Strukturen schaffen: Du baust belastbare Controlling-Strukturen und Reportings mit einer klaren, zukunftsorientierten Steuerungslogik auf.
- Finanzen im Griff: Du übernimmst die Gesamtverantwortung für unsere Finanzplanung, das Reporting und die strategische finanzielle Steuerung.
- Data-Infrastruktur gestalten: Du treibst den Aufbau unserer automatisierten Datenpipelines voran (u. a. BigQuery, angebunden an Shopify, Klaviyo und weitere Quellen) und sorgst dafür, dass Kennzahlen zuverlässig, aktuell und zentral verfügbar sind.
- BI & Controlling verzahnen: Du entwickelst unsere Dashboards und Reporting-Tools (z. B. Looker Studio) so weiter, dass Finance-Kennzahlen und operative Daten in einem konsistenten Bild zusammenlaufen.
- Prozesse skalieren: Du etablierst effiziente, smarte Prozesse im Finance- und Data-Bereich, die mit uns mitwachsen.
- Sparring auf Augenhöhe: Du arbeitest eng mit unserem CEO zusammen und berätst ihn als geschätzter Sparringspartnerin in allen strategischen Finanz- und Datenfragen.

Das steckt in deiner Haut Vorab: Niemand ist perfekt! Wenn du nicht jeden einzelnen Punkt zu 100 % erfüllst, uns aber mit deiner Motivation überzeugt, wollen wir dich trotzdem kennenlernen.

- Dein Fundament: Du blickst auf mehrjährige fundierte Erfahrung im Finance-Bereich zurück und bringst einen starken Background im Controlling mit.
- Deine zweite Stärke: Du konntest bereits mehrjährige Erfahrung im Aufbau oder Betrieb von Daten-Infrastruktur sammeln (z. B. Data Warehouses, ETL-Pipelines, BI-Tools) und weißt, worauf es bei moderner, skalierbarer Datenarchitektur ankommt.
- Dein Branchenwissen: Idealerweise hast du schon einmal im dynamischen E-Commerce- oder Consumer-Umfeld gearbeitet.
- Deine Persönlichkeit: Du zeichnest dich durch eine strukturierte, absolut verlässliche und gleichzeitig pragmatische Hands-on-Mentalität aus.
- Deine Mentalität: Eigenmotivation, Lösungsorientierung und der Wille, Neues zu lernen, sind für dich selbstverständlich.
- Deine Sprache: Du kommunizierst sicher und fließend auf Deutsch (Muttersprachniveau).

Deine Benefits: We care for you - Werde Teil eines aufgeschlossenen Teams mit flachen Hierarchien und kurzen Entscheidungswegen 
- Bei uns kannst du von Tag Eins an Verantwortung übernehmen und Deine eigenen Ideen vorantreiben 
- Regelmäßige Feedbackgespräche sowie Umfragen, um das Arbeitsumfeld und die Unternehmenskultur stetig zu verbessern
- Arbeite so, wie Du am produktivsten bist; profitiere von flexiblen Arbeitszeiten und der Möglichkeit, gelegentlich aus dem Homeoffice zu arbeiten
- Bleibe aktiv! Bei uns erhältst Du eine Bezuschussung zu Deiner EGYM Wellpass oder Urban Sports Club Mitgliedschaft
- Kümmere Dich um Dein mentales Wohlbefinden: Nutze die Möglichkeit Dir über OpenUp Online-Sitzungen mit ausgebildeten Psycholog*innen zu buchen sowie an zahlreichen Workshops und Webinaren teilzunehmen

- Natürlich gibt es bei uns auch einen Mitarbeiter*innen-Rabatt auf JUNGLÜCK-Produkte, außerdem erhältst Du Zugänge zu Plattformen, die Dir Vergünstigungen bei weiteren (nachhaltigen) Unternehmen bieten

title: AI Growth Marketer (m/w/d) - remote
description:
Deine Rolle Wir sind ein kleines, agiles Marketing-Team. Jede und jeder übernimmt hier Ownership, entwickelt eigene Strategien und setzt sie selbst um. Seit wir konsequent mit AI arbeiten, sehen wir deutlich mehr Chancen zu wachsen, als wir bisher angehen können. Deshalb holen wir jemanden dazu, der sich alles übergreifend ansieht, die größten Hebel erkennt und sie selbst in die Hand nimmt.
Du verantwortest Growth-Projekte end-to-end, auf bestehenden Kanälen und auf neuen, die Du selbst findest. Du baust selbst, stellst selbst live in der App, im App Store oder auf der Website, und wertest die Daten danach aus. Die Wege sind kurz, der komplette Projektzyklus liegt bei Dir.

Deine Aufgaben: - Chancen in unseren Produkten finden. Du gehst regelmäßig durch Website, App Stores, Content, Jobboards und den Funnel bis Premium und findest die Stellen mit dem größten Hebel für Registrierungen und Umsatz.
- Chancen im Markt erkennen. Du schaust genauso nach außen: Welche Trends und Plattformen bewegen unsere Zielgruppe gerade, welche Segmente oder Märkte lohnen einen Einstieg, welche Wachstumskanäle sollten wir aktivieren, die wir heute nicht nutzen, und was machen Wettbewerber.
- Chancen bewerten und priorisieren. Du schätzt vorher ab, was realistisch drin ist und was es bringt, und bringst eine Shortlist ins Team. 
- Selbst bauen und selbst live stellen. Du baust Landing Pages, Tests und Kampagnenbausteine mit AI und veröffentlichst sie selbst. Kein Ticket bei Engineering, kein Warten auf Design, keine Warteschlange. 
- Testen und messen. Du setzt A/B-Tests auf der Website, in den App Stores und auf unseren weiteren Plattformen auf, wertest sie sauber aus und iterierst. 
- App Store Optimisation . Du testest Screenshots, Icon, Titel und Beschreibungen laufend weiter.
- Akquisition und früher Funnel. Dein Fokus liegt auf der Gewinnung neuer Nutzer. Gemeinsam mit dem Product Team bewertet Ihr, welche Zielgruppen und Kanäle den besten LTV bringen, und verbessert danach die Signup- und Activation-Flows im frühen Funnel.
- Copy und Botschaften. Du formulierst, was StudySmarter Lernenden bringt, so dass es bei unserer Zielgruppe ankommt und konvertiert. Headlines auf Landing Pages, Ad-Copy, Video-Skripte, Plakatmotive und mehr. 
- Content und Kampagnen mit AI. AI-Content-Projekte, Markenaufbau für unsere Jobboards, Out-of-Home-Kampagnen.
- Love Brand aufbauen. Du entwickelst gemeinsam mit uns eine globale Love Brand für B2C und B2B und prägst mit, wie StudySmarter aussieht und klingt.

Was die Rolle nicht ist - Keine klassische Designstelle. Geschmack und Markenurteil sind wichtig, die handwerkliche Ausführung läuft über AI und Freelancer.
- Kein Performance-Marketing-Job. Kanäle, Budget, Bidding und Attribution liegen an anderer Stelle im Team.
- Keine Briefing-Rolle. Du machst die Arbeit selbst, statt sie weiterzugeben.
- Keine Product-Rolle. Du bist kein Product Manager. Du trägst die Nutzerakquisition und arbeitest dafür eng mit dem Product Team zusammen, ohne Produktverantwortung zu übernehmen.
- Keine Führungsrolle. Du arbeitest eng im Marketing-Team und gemeinsam mit dem Gründerteam, führst aber keine eigenen Mitarbeitenden. Dafür deutlich mehr Gestaltungsspielraum.

Was du für diese Rolle brauchst - Starke AI-Skills. Du arbeitest täglich mit AI-Tools wie Claude Code, Codex oder ähnlichen, dazu mit Agents und Automatisierung. Du baust eigene Seiten, Tools und Workflows und bringst sie selbst live, statt nur Prompts zu schreiben.
- Starkes Copywriting und Storytelling. Du schreibst Texte, die auffallen und konvertieren, und findest die
Worte, die bei Schülerinnen, Schülern und Studierenden ankommen. Du denkst in Geschichten und Nutzen, nicht in Feature-Listen.
- Eigenständigkeit und Tempo. Du nimmst ein Thema und bringst es durch. Zehn Dinge live und gemessen sind Dir lieber als zwei perfekte. Zahlenverständnis. Du liest Funnel selbst, arbeitest in Analytics-Tools und bewertest Tests ehrlich, auch wenn
das Ergebnis gegen Deine Idee spricht.
- Ein Auge für Design. Du erkennst, was gut aussieht und was nicht, und kannst einschätzen, wann Design
Conversion bringt und wann es nur Dekoration ist. Figma ist Dir vertraut.
- Marketing-Grundverständnis. Du weißt, wie Paid, SEO und Lifecycle grundsätzlich funktionieren. Die Details der einzelnen Kanäle lernst Du bei uns.
Zwei Dinge sind Voraussetzung: - Deutsch auf Muttersprachniveau. Du schreibst für unsere Zielgruppe auf Landing Pages, in
Ads, in den App Stores und offline. Ohne echtes Sprachgefühl funktioniert das nicht.
- Eigene Projekte, die Du zeigen kannst. Seiten, Tools, Content, Nebenprojekte. Das sagt uns
mehr als ein Lebenslauf.

Wir schauen auf Skills, Execution, Tempo, Kreativität und Ambition, nicht auf die Anzahl der Berufsjahre. Starke
Absolventinnen und Absolventen sind ausdrücklich willkommen, ebenso Profile mit einigen Jahren Erfahrung.

Warum StudySmarter? - Remote arbeiten, so viel Du möchtest
- Modernes Büro mit Terrasse, mitten im Münchner Werksviertel
- Beteiligung am Unternehmenserfolg
- Ausstattung nach Deiner Wahl
- Direkter Draht zu den Foundern
- EGYM Wellpass für Sport und Gesundheit
- Obst, Säfte, Porridge-Bar und Getränke-Flatrate
- Regelmäßige Team-Events, Sommer- und
- Weihnachtsfeier
- Budget für Fortbildung und Weiterentwicklung
- Ein Umfeld, in dem Du AI nicht rechtfertigen musst

Deine Bewerbung Schick uns Deinen CV und Links zu AI-Projekten, die Du verantwortet hast. Ein Anschreiben ist optional. Und zeig uns etwas, das Du in den letzten drei Monaten mit AI gebaut hast. Ein paar Absätze oder ein kurzes Video genügen.

Wir schätzen unterschiedliche Erfahrungen und Perspektiven und ermutigen alle Menschen, sich zu
bewerben, auch wenn nicht jede Anforderung perfekt erfüllt ist. Wenn Du unsicher bist, ob Dein Profil passt,
bewirb Dich und lass es uns beurteilen.

title: (Junior) Campaign Manager (m/w/d) – remote
description:
Deine Rolle Die Stelle ist zunächst auf ein Jahr befristet. Uns ist eine langfristige Zusammenarbeit wichtig, daher ist eine Übernahme in eine unbefristete Anstellung angestrebt.

Als Campaign Manager*in bist du das Herzstück unserer Kundenprojekte: Du verbindest kreatives Marketing, strategische Beratung und operative Exzellenz, um Top-Brands und Arbeitgeber perfekt auf unserer Plattform und Social Media zu inszenieren. Dabei bist du für folgende Themenschwerpunkte verantwortlich:
- End-to-End Kampagnensteuerung: Du planst, betreust und wickelst Werbekampagnen für unsere Kunden und Agenturen ab. Von der ersten Idee bis zur finalen Umsetzung hast du das Heft fest in der Hand.
- Multichannel-Setup & Operations: Du setzt Kampagnen zeitgerecht in unseren eigenen Inhouse-Tools sowie auf Social Media um und managst flexibel Umbuchungen oder Stornierungen.
- Employer Branding & Jobbörse: Du betreust Employer-Branding-Kampagnen unserer Partner, legst zielgruppenstarke Stellenanzeigen an und verwaltest diese passgenau auf unserer StudySmarter Jobbörse, um Arbeitgeber optimal bei der Gen Z zu positionieren.
- Kreativ-Workflows & Design-Beratung: Du berätst unsere Kunden zur visuellen Gestaltung und Zielgruppenansprache, erstellst Mailings und baust ansprechende Kundenprofile auf.
- Sales-Schnittstelle & Support: Du arbeitest eng mit dem Sales-Team zusammen, bildest die Schnittstelle zu allen vertriebsrelevanten Bereichen und unterstützt aktiv bei der Weiterentwicklung von Marketing- und Vertriebsaktionen.
- Data-driven After-Sales: Du analysierst die Kampagnen-Performance, erstellst aussagekräftige Reportings und präsentierst die Ergebnisse überzeugend vor unseren Kunden.

Was du für diese Rolle brauchst - Background: Idealerweise hast du erste praktische Erfahrung im Online-Marketing, einer (Media-)Agentur, im HR-Marketing/Employer Branding oder einem vergleichbaren Umfeld – auch motivierte Quereinsteiger*innen sind bei uns herzlich willkommen!
- Kommunikationsstärke: Verhandlungssichere Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse sowie echte Freude am direkten, beratenden Kundenkontakt.
- Organisationstalent: Ein hervorragendes Zeitmanagement, eine strukturierte Arbeitsweise und die Fähigkeit, in dynamischen Phasen die richtigen Prioritäten zu setzen.
- Markengespür & Kundenfokus: Ein geschultes Auge für gutes Design, Kreativität und ein tiefes Verständnis für die unterschiedlichen B2B-Kundenbedürfnisse.
- Mindset: Hohe Eigenmotivation, der Wille zur persönlichen Weiterentwicklung und die Leidenschaft, ein stark wachsendes EdTech-Unternehmen mit der Vision „Besseres Lernen für alle“ aktiv mitzugestalten.
- Sprachen: Du sprichst absolut fließend Deutsch und kannst dich auf Englisch gut verständigen.

Warum StudySmarter? Wir sind längst mehr als eine Lern-App - StudySmarter begleitet Millionen Menschen von der Schule über das Studium bis in den Berufseinstieg. Dabei bewegen wir uns an der Schnittstelle aus Tech, Social Impact und internationalem Wachstum: Wir setzen früh auf neue Technologien, insbesondere KI, und entwickeln Produkt und Prozesse kontinuierlich weiter. title: Senior UI/UX Designer (all genders)
description:
Über ]init[ Du möchtest die Gesellschaft von morgen mitgestalten? Dann bist du bei ]init[ richtig. Denn unsere digitalen Lösungen sind für Menschen gemacht und haben gesellschaftliche Relevanz. Klingt spannend? Dann steig ein und arbeite gemeinsam mit über 1.400 ]init[s in interdisziplinären Teams an unseren sieben Standorten – oder flexibel von überall in Deutschland aus.

Deine Mission bei ]init[ Du gestaltest digitale Anwendungen, die Menschen wirklich nutzen – und du denkst dabei nicht erst ab dem Screen, sondern ab dem Kundenziel und Nutzungsproblem. Als Senior UI/UX Designer (all genders) trägst du in interdisziplinären Projektteams die Verantwortung für die Gestaltung und Nutzerzentrierung komplexer Fachanwendungen, Portale und Informationsangebote – im Public und Health Sector ebenso wie in regulierten Branchen der Privatwirtschaft, etwa im Energiesektor.

Du bewegst dich sicher zwischen Kundenanforderungen, Erkenntnissen aus der Nutzerforschung, Konzeption und visueller Umsetzung: Du denkst Design strategisch, treibst Design-Prozesse voran und verbindest konzeptionelle Stärke mit einem hohen Maß an visueller Präzision – auch an der Schnittstelle zwischen Gestaltung und technischer Umsetzung. Designsysteme sind für dich dabei kein Nebenprodukt, sondern das Rückgrat deiner Arbeit: Du baust sie auf, hältst sie über Produkte hinweg konsistent und sorgst dafür, dass sie in der Entwicklung tatsächlich ankommen. Und du nutzt KI dort, wo sie deine Arbeit besser macht: schneller zu Varianten und Umsetzung, breiter in Recherche und Analyse, konsequenter in der Qualitätssicherung – ohne die Entscheidung aus der Hand zu geben.

Das gibt es zu tun - Du verantwortest den Designprozess in Kundenprojekten, von der Vision und Definition der Design-Sprache bis zum finalen UI. Du gestaltest visuell und fachlich anspruchsvolle Benutzerflows und Oberflächen für komplexe Anwendungen konsistent, zugänglich und umsetzbar
- Du berätst strategisch unsere Kund:innen und Projektteams bei der Weiterentwicklung ihrer digitalen Produkte: Du bringst Nutzersicht und Marktbeobachtung zusammen, zeigst Optionen auf und begründest Designentscheidungen so, dass sie im Haus des Kunden tragen
- Du verantwortest Designsysteme über ihren gesamten Lebenszyklus und sorgst dafür, dass das Designsystem im Team gelebt wird: Dokumentation, Contribution-Regeln, Reviews und Schulung von Kolleg:innen und Kund:innen
- Du berätst Kund:innen auf Augenhöhe, moderierst Workshops und machst Designentscheidungen nachvollziehbar – auch gegenüber nicht-gestalterischen Stakeholdern. Wo Produkt und Kommunikation zusammenwirken, denkst du beides zusammen
- Du übernimmst die kreative Federführung bei Angeboten und Ausschreibungen und präsentierst in Pitches
- Du setzt KI-Tools gezielt im Designprozess ein und teilst deine Erfahrungen im Team
- Du übernimmst du die fachliche Leitung kleiner UX/UI-Teams in Kundenprojekten, gibst Impulse ins Team durch Design Reviews, Qualitätssicherung und Mentoring von Kolleg:innen

Das bringst du mit Must-haves 
- Mindestens 5 Jahre Erfahrung in der Konzeption und Gestaltung digitaler Produkte mit Schwerpunkt UX- und UI-Design
- Abgeschlossenes Studium in Kommunikationsdesign, Interaction Design, Medieninformatik, Human-Computer Interaction (HCI) oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation.
- Fundierte Erfahrung in der Entwicklung, Anwendung und Weiterentwicklung von Designsystemen sowie ein ausgeprägtes Qualitätsverständnis und visuelles Stilgefühl
- Sicherer Umgang mit UX-Methoden, der Gestaltung komplexer digitaler Anwendungen sowie den Anforderungen an digitale Barrierefreiheit
- Erfahrung in der Zusammenarbeit mit Entwicklungsteams in agilen Umfeldern sowie in der Moderation von Workshops und Präsentation von Designlösungen gegenüber Kund:innen und Stakeholdern.
- Aussagekräftiges Portfolio, in dem du deine Arbeit von der Problemstellung bis zum finalen Interface sowie deine Erfahrung mit Designsystemen zeigst
- Sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift. 
Nice-to-haves - Erfahrung in regulierten Branchen wie Public Sector, Health, Energie.
- Erfahrung in der fachlichen Führung kleiner Designteams in Kundenprojekten.
- Erfahrung in der Art Direktion
- Praktische Erfahrung mit KI-gestützten Produkten, Designprozessen, Prototyping oder Code-Generierung.

- Grow with us: Profitiere von bereichsübergreifendem Wissensaustausch und entwickle dich gemeinsam mit deinen Kolleg:innen kontinuierlich weiter.
- Ride with us: JobRad, ÖPNV-Zuschuss und weitere Mobility Benefits unterstützen dich dabei, flexibel und nachhaltig unterwegs zu sein.
- Start with us: Welcome Week, strukturiertes Onboarding und Patenschaften sorgen für einen gelungenen Einstieg und helfen dir, schnell im Team und deinen Projekten anzukommen.

Werde Teil des Teams Gestalte mit uns die digitale Zukunft – in Vollzeit oder Teilzeit, remote oder im Office.

title: Accounts Payable Assistant
description:
What We’re All About. 

Quantexa is a global leader in AI-powered Decision Intelligence. As one of the UK's fastest-growing tech companies, we're on a mission to help organizations make better, more trusted decisions. As we continue our rapid global expansion, we are looking for a diligent and detail-oriented Accounts Payable Assistant to join our dynamic finance team.

At Q, we’re looking for people who share that vision. People like you. 

The Opportunity. 

As an Accounts Payable Assistant, you will be a vital part of the team that keeps our financial engine running smoothly. You will be responsible for ensuring our suppliers are paid accurately and on time, maintaining strong relationships, and supporting the integrity of our financial data. This is a fantastic opportunity to develop your finance career within a fast-paced, high-growth global technology company.

What You’ll Be Doing. 

- Processing a high volume of supplier invoices with exceptional accuracy, ensuring they are correctly coded and authorised.

- Performing three-way matching of invoices to purchase orders and receipts.

- Preparing and processing weekly payment runs for multiple currencies and entities.

- Acting as a primary point of contact for supplier queries, resolving issues professionally and efficiently.

- Reconciling supplier statements and investigating and resolving any discrepancies.

- Assisting the AP team with month-end close procedures and accruals.

- Championing best practices by encouraging the use of our Procure-to-Pay (P2P) systems across the business.

What You’ll Bring. 

- Experience: You have previous experience working in an Accounts Payable or a similar transactional finance role.

- Attention to Detail: You have meticulous attention to detail and a commitment to accuracy.

- Organisational Skills: You are highly organised, with the ability to manage multiple tasks and meet deadlines in a fast-paced environment.

- A Proactive Mindset: You are a proactive, positive, and collaborative team player with strong problem-solving skills.

- Communication: You have excellent written and verbal communication skills.

- Systems: You are proficient in Microsoft Excel.

Bonus Points If You Have: 

- Experience working within a high-growth tech or SaaS company.

- Hands-on experience with ERP systems like NetSuite and spend management tools like Navan or Expensify.

Our mission. 

We have one mission. To help businesses grow. To make data easier. And to make the world a better place. We’re not a start-up. Not anymore. But we’ve not been around that long either. What we are is a collection of bright, passionate minds harnessing complexities and helping our clients and their communities. One culture, made of many. Heading in one direction – the future.

It’s all about you. 

We want you to feel welcome, valued, and respected - because it’s your individuality and passion that make you Q . We see that, and we celebrate it. That’s why we’re proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer.

We are committed to fostering an inclusive and diverse work environment, continuously improving to ensure everyone belongs. Our recruitment process is designed to be inclusive and accessible. If you need any reasonable adjustments or accommodations, please let our Talent Acquisition Team know - we’re happy to assist. 

No matter your race, beliefs, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, neurodiversity, or abilities—whoever you are—if you're a passionate, curious, and caring human eager to push the boundaries of what’s possible, we want to hear from you.

title: Financial Controller (Process & Control)
description:
What We’re All About. 

Quantexa is a global leader in AI-powered Decision Intelligence. As one of the UK's fastest-growing tech companies, we're on a mission to help organisations make better, more trusted decisions. As we continue our rapid global expansion, we are looking for a commercially minded and technically strong finance professional to join our dynamic finance team.

At Q, we’re looking for people who share that vision. People like you. 

The opportunity. 

What you’ll be doing. 

We are seeking an experienced Financial Lead in processes and control to help modernise and scale a global finance function operating across a complex, multi-entity, multi-jurisdiction environment.

Reporting to the VP Finance, you will lead initiatives that improve the effectiveness, efficiency and scalability of Finance through process redesign, technology enablement, data governance and operational excellence.

This role sits at the intersection of finance operations, systems, data and business performance. You will be responsible for transforming core finance processes, improving controls, implementing enabling technologies and ensuring that transformation initiatives deliver measurable and sustainable business value.

Unlike a traditional programme management role, success will not be measured solely by project delivery. You will be expected to challenge assumptions, validate outcomes and ensure that process and system changes translate into tangible improvements in close efficiency, reporting quality, control effectiveness and decision-making.

You will play a key role in consolidating information from a diverse systems landscape, improving data quality and governance, and helping establish a single source of truth for financial and operational reporting.

What you’ll bring. 

Finance Process Transformation & Operational Excellence 

- Assist in the design and implementation of the Finance Target Operating Model (TOM), covering processes, systems and data, providing input and recommendations to support the overall TOM design.

description:
📍 London (Hybrid – 2 days in office, 3 days remote/WFH or office if you prefer!) 

Two in five people in the UK rent their homes. At Goodlord, our mission is to be the gold standard platform for renting - simplifying complexity across agents, landlords and tenants.

We’re looking for a hands-on Head of Brand to own how Goodlord shows up in the world - from our brand and content to PR, corporate affairs and thought leadership.

This is a role for someone who brings together brand ownership and PR/communications. You’ll have experience owning and shaping a B2B brand - its positioning, messaging, identity and how it shows up in market - alongside strong, hands-on PR and media experience.

You’ll have built that experience within B2B technology/SaaS, or in a PR and communications agency working with B2B technology clients. That combination is important: we need someone who is as comfortable thinking about our brand and positioning as they are shaping a story, working with journalists and building our reputation.

Reporting directly to our Marketing Director, you’ll lead a team of four across content, SEO and design, manage our external PR agency and work closely with colleagues across Demand Generation, Product Marketing, Sales and the wider business.

You’ll help make Goodlord a distinctive and trusted voice in the industry, turning complex topics - from regulation and policy to AI and technology - into stories people actually want to read, hear and talk about.

If you like autonomy, pace and variety - and you’re comfortable being the person who both shapes what great looks like and helps make it happen - this could be a great fit!

WHAT YOU’LL BE DOING 

- Owning our brand - shaping and evolving Goodlord’s positioning, messaging, identity and voice, and making sure we show up consistently and distinctively

- Leading PR, media and corporate affairs - owning our day-to-day PR and media activity, building relationships with journalists, spotting and shaping stories, managing our external PR agency and leading our approach to regulatory, policy and reputation-related communications

- Shaping our stories - turning complex industry, regulatory and technology topics into compelling narratives and thought leadership, working with senior leaders where needed

- Leading content and SEO - setting the direction for our content and SEO specialists, helping them create useful, engaging work that supports our brand and wider business priorities

- Leading creative and design - setting clear direction for our in-house designers and making sure everything we put into the world feels unmistakably Goodlord

- Connecting brand to the business - partnering with Demand Generation, Product Marketing and Sales to make sure brand, PR and content support our wider commercial goals

ABOUT YOU 

You’ll be well suited to this role if you:

- Have strong commercial experience across brand and PR/communications, gained within B2B technology/SaaS or a PR and communications agency working with B2B technology clients, or a mix of both! 

- Have owned and shaped a brand - its positioning, messaging, identity and how it shows up in market - rather than solely delivering brand campaigns or driving brand awareness

- Have strong, hands-on PR and media experience, with a track record of building journalist relationships, shaping stories and delivering earned coverage

- Are a strong storyteller with sound strategic judgement, able to zoom out to brand strategy and zoom in to a single headline

- Have experience across corporate affairs, reputation management and thought leadership, including working with senior leaders on external communications

- Have experience directly leading and developing individual contributors, with the judgement to set direction across content, SEO and creative

- Are commercially minded, collaborative and enjoy having ownership while staying close to the work

This role is about owning delivery, not building a large function. If you’re looking for a purely strategic communications role with a sizeable team underneath you, this probably isn’t the right fit. If you enjoy being close to the work and making things happen, we’d love to hear from you! 

Why you'll love being a Goodlordian 

Aside from the role, the people, our culture and our mission, we have some other things that make Goodlord a pretty awesome place to be. Here’s a few favourites amongst Goodlordians (check out our careers page for more info).

- Grow with Goodlord: your development is important to us, that’s why we are Great Place to Work - certified . Have a goal in mind? Share it with us so we can use some of our annual development fund to support it. We guarantee you’ll learn loads and develop both personally and professionally!

- Your well-being matters: bi-weekly coaching with Sanctus to provide Goodlordians with a safe place to talk and support your mental health

- 25 days holiday (plus UK Bank holidays) plus 1 day per full holiday year up to 32 days: We believe regular breaks are essential for well-being and we encourage (some may say expect!) all Goodlordians to take full advantage of their annual leave entitlement.

- Supporting your family: we offer Goodlordians of all genders a generous 3 months of fully-paid time off to look after their new arrivals

- Our team: we’re an energetic, sociable, and talented bunch who are super passionate about what we do and determined to make a difference. We’re all in it together, we learn from each other, we’re genuine and we don’t have time for politics

What’s next?

If you’re ready to help us on our mission to be the gold standard platform for renting, then click apply (2-3 minutes)!

title: Senior Optical Packaging & Assembly Engineer
description:
PsiQuantum’s mission is to build the first useful quantum computers—machines capable of delivering the breakthroughs the field has long promised. Since our founding in 2016, our singular focus has been to build and deploy million-qubit, fault-tolerant quantum systems. 

Quantum computers harness the laws of quantum mechanics to solve problems that even the most advanced supercomputers or AI systems will never reach. Their impact will span energy, pharmaceuticals, finance, agriculture, transportation, materials, and other foundational industries. 

Our architecture and approach is based on silicon photonics. By leveraging the advanced semiconductor manufacturing industry—including partners like GlobalFoundries—we use the same high-volume processes that already produce billions of chips for telecom and consumer electronics. Photonics offers natural advantages for scale: photons don’t feel heat, are immune to electromagnetic interference, and integrate with existing cryogenic cooling and standard fiber-optic infrastructure. 

In 2024, PsiQuantum announced government-funded projects to support the build-out of our first utility-scale quantum computers in Brisbane, Australia, and Chicago, Illinois. These initiatives reflect a growing recognition that quantum computing will be strategically and economically defining—and that now is the time to scale. 

PsiQuantum also develops the algorithms and software needed to make these systems commercially valuable. Our application, software, and industry teams work directly with leading Fortune 500 companies—including Lockheed Martin, Mercedes-Benz, Boehringer Ingelheim, and Mitsubishi Chemical—to prepare quantum solutions for real-world impact. 

Quantum computing is not an extension of classical computing. It represents a fundamental shift—and a path to mastering challenges that cannot be solved any other way. The potential is enormous, and we have a clear path to make it real. 

Come join us. 

Job Summary: 

The Senior Optical Packaging Engineer is responsible for developing & implementing high-performance, robust & scalable opto-electronic packaging workflows for a variety of chip-based photonic integrated circuits. This work will be carried out in PsiQuantum’s UK R&D facility located in Daresbury Lab.

Responsibilities: 

- Develop an optical package and fibre-to-chip alignment scheme that allows for high alignment accuracy and scalable assembly.

- Help develop packaging prototypes & scalable fibre-to-chip packaging flows and processes.

- Review packaging design BOMs, work with supply chain on procuring parts needed for assembly.

- Work with our internal packaging team and external vendors on transferring & scaling packaging designs and processes based on successful prototypes.

- Work with external vendors and suppliers to source required materials and provide feedback on evolving requirements. 

- Working with external partners to develop advanced opto-electronic packaging solutions.

Experience/Qualifications: 

- Master’s Degree or above in Optical Engineering, Physics or equivalent.

- 3+ years of experience working on PIC packaging design & qualification.

- 5+ years of experience working with optical fibers, optical measurements.

- 3+ years of experience working on FAU / optical connector to chip attachment.

- Experience with optical data analysis.

title: Senior Producer
description:
Scopely is looking for a Senior Producer to join the Live Game organisation supporting the MONOPOLY GO! team. This role is remote within the EU and will support our Barcelona and Sevilla hubs.

At Scopely, we care deeply about what we do and strive to inspire play every day—through our work alongside talented colleagues and through our connection with millions of players around the world.

MONOPOLY GO! is one of Scopely’s flagship mobile free-to-play franchises and one of the largest games in the mobile industry. 

With teams distributed across Barcelona, Sevilla, the United States, and other global locations, this role requires strong production leadership, excellent communication, and exceptional attention to detail.

About the Role 

As a Senior Producer within the Live Game organization, you will oversee development across one or more live game workstreams, helping transform product strategy and creative goals into high-quality player experiences.

You will manage development from early planning and team alignment through implementation, integration, QA, release, and live support. This includes coordinating concurrent initiatives, managing complex dependency chains, driving change request flow, and ensuring teams remain focused on delivering meaningful player and business outcomes.

This is a hands-on, in-the-weeds production role requiring both strategic thinking and tactical execution. You will work closely with Product, Design, Engineering, Art, Content, Economy, QA, Localization, Analytics, Live Operations, and Release Management to deliver at the pace and quality expected of a global mobile live-service game.

What You Will Do 

- Own the end-to-end production lifecycle for assigned Live Game development workstreams, from discovery and planning through development, release, and post-launch support.

- Manage multiple concurrent initiatives with shared teams, resources, dependencies, and shifting priorities.

- Translate product strategy and roadmap objectives into clear, executable development plans.

- Build and maintain integrated schedules, milestone plans, critical paths, risk registers, and dependency maps.

- Establish clear DRIs, requirements, acceptance criteria, decision points, and delivery expectations for major initiatives.

- Manage the complete mobile live-service development lifecycle, including design alignment, implementation, configuration, integration, QA validation, release readiness, live activation, and post-launch follow-up.

- Partner with Live Operations and Release Management to ensure development work is compatible with the LiveOps calendar, release cadence, player priorities, and operational requirements.

- Lead the change request process by assessing the impact of proposed changes on scope, schedule, capacity, quality, risk, and downstream dependencies.

- Drive prioritization and decision-making around change requests, communicate approved changes clearly, and ensure plans and systems remain aligned with the latest direction.

- Proactively identify blockers, bottlenecks, gaps in ownership, and risks to delivery. Resolve issues directly where possible and escalate with clear recommendations when necessary.

- Facilitate milestone reviews, sprint planning, production checkpoints, risk reviews, and cross-functional working sessions.

- Ensure meetings result in clear decisions, owners, deadlines, and follow-through.

- Maintain accurate and current project information across Jira, Airtable, Confluence, and other production systems.

- Communicate project status, risks, dependencies, decisions, and delivery confidence clearly to both senior leadership and development teams across the Barcelona and Sevilla hubs.

- Partner with Live Operations after launch to support issue triage, player-impacting investigations, post-launch actions, and continuous improvement.

- Use player data, team feedback, and operational insights to inform prioritization and improve future development planning.

- Champion improvements to development workflows, production practices, tooling, and cross-functional collaboration across the Live Game organization.

What We’re Looking For 

- 5+ years of experience in game production, with significant experience in mobile free-to-play or live-service games.

- Proven experience managing the development and delivery of mobile game features, systems, content, events, or other player-facing experiences.

- Strong understanding of Live Operations, including high-frequency content delivery, live calendars, release cycles, remote configuration, QA validation, launch readiness, and post-launch support.

- Experience managing multiple concurrent development workstreams with complex cross-functional dependencies.

- Strong understanding of roadmap planning, milestone management, critical-path tracking, risk management, change management, and delivery readiness.

- Experience partnering closely with Engineering and technical teams, with an understanding of client/server dependencies, configuration, integration, and mobile release considerations.

- Demonstrated ability to manage dependency escalation, negotiate tradeoffs, and create accountability across teams.

- Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to bring clarity to complex or ambiguous situations.

- Exceptional attention to detail and a strong sense of ownership for the quality and accuracy of production information.

- Proficiency with tools such as Jira, Airtable, Confluence, Google Workspace, or similar project-management systems.

- Ability to operate at both strategic and tactical levels, from shaping a development roadmap to following individual deliverables through completion.

- A player-focused mindset and passion for building engaging, polished, and continuously evolving mobile game experiences.

The Ideal Candidate 

- Is highly organized, structured, dependable, and comfortable operating in a high-volume Live Operations environment.

- Understands the realities of mobile free-to-play development, including rapid iteration, global releases, frequent content updates, live player impact, and operational precision.

- Drives outcomes beyond task tracking and status reporting.

- Anticipates problems before they become delivery issues.

- Communicates directly, diplomatically, and consistently across global teams and time zones.

- Creates accountability without unnecessary process or bureaucracy.

- Is comfortable challenging unclear plans, identifying gaps, and driving decisions.

- Can manage competing priorities while maintaining focus on the critical path.

- Brings sound judgment, energy, and a collaborative mindset to a fast-paced, globally distributed development organization.

- Cares deeply about both the quality of the player experience and the operational excellence required to deliver it.

About Scopely

Scopely is a leading video game and global interactive entertainment company, home to many of the world’s most beloved and enduring experiences, including two of the most successful mobile games of all-time “MONOPOLY GO!” and “Pokémon GO,” along with “Stumble Guys,” “Star Trek™ Fleet Command,” “MARVEL Strike Force,” “WWE Champions,” the Scrabble® franchise, “Yahtzee® With Buddies,” and many others. Across mobile, web, PC, and console, Scopely creates, develops, publishes, and live-operates one of the most diversified and award-winning portfolios in the games industry — bringing hundreds of millions of players together through a shared love of play.

Founded in 2011, Scopely is powered by its exceptional team — including thousands of world-class gamemakers around the globe, a distinctive tenet-driven culture, and its proprietary technology platform, Playgami. Together, these strengths have fueled Scopely’s position as the #1 mobile games company in the U.S. and #2 globally, generating more than $10 billion in lifetime revenue. Whether building global sensations like “MONOPOLY GO!” from the ground up, or expanding through strategic acquisitions, including the FoxNext, GSN, and Scopely Explore games businesses — Scopely consistently delivers experiences players love today and return to for years to come.

Recognized multiple times as one of the "100 Most Influential Companies in the World" by TIME magazine and one of Fast Company's "World's Most Innovative Companies" and “Best Workplaces for Innovators,” Scopely believes that video games can be a force for good — creating meaningful connections, vibrant communities, and making life better through play.

title: AI Strategy Analyst

The Role 

We are looking for a technically-minded individual with a deep personal interest in AI/ML to join the DMFI COO Office as a dedicated AI Strategy Analyst. We need someone who can get hands-on with training, datasets, prompt engineering, and implementation, while continuing to advocate for DMFI priorities with the platform AI team.

The ideal candidate is 3-5 years out of university, likely with a PhD or strong technical background (computer science, data science, computational finance, physics, engineering, or similar), who has a genuine base-case curiosity about AI and can grow into a leadership position as the function scales. We value intellectual horsepower and hunger over years of experience.

What You'll Do 

AI Implementation & Hands-On Delivery

- Own the end-to-end implementation of AI tools and workflows for DMFI PMs and analysts — from scoping use cases through to production deployment and adoption tracking.

- Build, test, and refine custom prompts, skill libraries, and automated workflows tailored to macro/fixed income investment processes.

- Develop and maintain custom datasources (vectorised document stores, research embeddings, email ingestion pipelines) that PMs can query via SchonAI/Claude.

- Work with proprietary pod-level data, market data (Bloomberg, Citi Velocity, DTCC), and internal analytics to create AI-accessible datasets.

Training & PM Adoption

- Design and deliver training programmes for PMs and analysts — from prompt engineering fundamentals to advanced Claude Code sessions.

- Create playbooks, best-practice guides, and reusable templates that lower the barrier to AI adoption.

- Identify and address friction points — token budgets, workflow gaps, awareness issues — to drive consistent adoption.

Data Strategy & Dataset Management

- Map and catalogue DMFI's data landscape: what data exists, where it lives, and how to make it AI-accessible.

- Drive the ingestion and embedding of key data sources: broker research (email and platform), central bank transcripts, internal research notes, and PM communications.

- Ensure data quality, naming conventions, and governance standards for all AI-accessible datasets.

- Work with Technology to build and maintain data pipelines that keep AI tools fed with current, relevant information.

Platform Liaison & Priority Advocacy

- Act as the primary interface between DMFI and the central AI/Technology team — representing PM priorities, advocating for resources, and ensuring DMFI's roadmap items are appropriately prioritized.

- Participate in cross-strategy AI working groups, share DMFI use cases, and import best practices from other strategy sets.

- Translate business requirements into technical specifications that the AI engineering team can deliver.

- Stay current on the rapidly evolving AI landscape (new models, tools, capabilities) and assess relevance for DMFI.

Compliance & Governance

- Ensure all AI-derived analytics and outputs have appropriate audit trails for compliance purposes.

- Work with Compliance to establish guardrails for AI usage in trading contexts.

- Maintain documentation of all active AI tools, datasets, and workflows.

What You'll Bring 

- 3-5 years post-university; PhD or Master's in a quantitative/technical discipline strongly preferred (Computer Science, Data Science, Machine Learning, Computational Finance, Physics, Mathematics, Engineering, or similar).

- Genuine, demonstrable passion for AI — personal projects, open-source contributions, research papers, or equivalent evidence of self-directed learning.

- Hands-on proficiency with Python; experience with ML frameworks (PyTorch, TensorFlow, HuggingFace), LLM APIs (OpenAI, Anthropic), and data manipulation libraries (pandas, numpy).

- Familiarity with NLP concepts: embeddings, vector databases, RAG architectures, prompt engineering, fine-tuning.

- Comfort working with large datasets and building data pipelines (SQL, cloud storage, APIs).

- Interest in or exposure to financial markets — particularly macro/fixed income — is a strong plus but not required; we will teach the domain to the right technical candidate.

- Excellent communication skills — ability to explain complex technical concepts to non-technical PMs and translate vague business needs into concrete technical solutions.

- Self-starter mentality: comfortable with ambiguity, able to prioritise independently, and driven to ship tangible outcomes rather than just produce analysis.

- Collaborative and low-ego; able to work across seniority levels from junior analysts to senior PMs and C-suite.

What Success Looks Like (First 12 Months) 

- Measurable increase in PM AI adoption rates across DMFI.

- At least 3-5 fully deployed, production-quality AI workflows generating demonstrable time savings or insight generation for PMs.

- Complete catalogue of DMFI datasets with clear AI-accessibility status and roadmap.

- Regular training cadence established with positive PM feedback.

- Clear prioritisation framework agreed with central AI team for DMFI-specific enhancements.

- Quantified ROI metrics linking AI usage to operational efficiency and/or investment edge.

Schonfeld is a global multi-manager hedge fund that strives to deliver industry-leading risk-adjusted returns for our investors. We leverage both internal and external portfolio manager teams around the world, seeking to capitalize on inefficiencies and opportunities within the markets. At Schonfeld, we’ll invest in you. Attracting and retaining top talent is at the heart of what we do, because we believe that exceptional outcomes begin with exceptional people. title: Agentic Systems Engineer (Digital Services)
description:
About us

At Cambridge Consultants, we believe the future of technology isn't just smart, it has agency. We're moving past passive tools and building human-centred digital services and products: systems that reason, plan, and act around the people who use them. Our work spans autonomous systems at the frontier of biology, sensing, and AI.

We hire self-motivated builders, not ticket-takers. If you thrive in highly agile environments, can cut through ambiguity with first-principles thinking, and want to ship things that matter, this is the kind of place where you'll feel at home.

About the role

You'll be working on systems that haven't existed before. Think of an Agentic Coach that navigates the unpredictability of human biology, or the software architecture behind a fully automated Dark Lab. These aren't chatbots waiting for questions. They're proactive systems that maintain world models, interpret human intent, and intervene before the user knows to ask. These systems create genuine impact for clients tackling problems no one else can solve.

Building them means designing and wiring agent harnesses: layered architectures that span from sensor-edge reasoning to high-level planning, backed by stateful multi-turn reasoning, persistent per-user memory, and robust evaluation pipelines.

You'll work in two directions at once. Internally, you'll use the latest AI tools to sharpen how we build, prototype, and ship. Externally, you'll deliver the breakthrough systems our clients deploy, designed to move from prototype to production at pace.

There's no single technology stack. You'll work with agents, multi-agent systems, and the latest generative AI tools, but your work will always be grounded in solid software engineering. Expect to build scalable distributed systems in core languages like Python and TypeScript, leveraging frameworks such as NextJS and Pydantic, agent orchestration tools (LangGraph, CrewAI), and protocols like MCP. You'll deploy on cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, Azure) using Docker, Kubernetes, and infrastructure-as-code, backed by rigorous CI/CD and observability (OpenTelemetry, Prometheus).

Due to the clients we work with, you must be eligible for UK security clearance.

What we ask of you

The examples below describe the core domains our AI Engineers own within the Digital Services team. We don't expect every candidate to have mastered all of these, but if you can demonstrate a strong combination of the following, we'd love to hear from you.

AI System Architecture: Designing and implementing the logic for autonomous systems, including maintaining world models, integrating multimodal sensing, and building real-time human-machine interaction loops.

Infrastructure & Production Engineering: Designing the underlying software for scalable, secure, and observable cloud deployments. You will apply the engineering rigor required to take experimental AI from concept to robust live launch.

Rapid Client Prototyping: Driving a demo-first delivery model. You will focus on fast experimentation to actively show tangible value and working software to clients, rather than describing it in slide decks.

Domain Translation & Integration: Partnering directly with deep-tech subject matter experts (like biologists and roboticists) to apply software solutions to complex physical constraints.

Indicators you'll be a good fit

Applied AI Expertise: You have hands-on experience utilising multi-agent frameworks, long-term memory systems, RAG pipelines, vector/graph databases, and reasoning-loop patterns (such as ReAct and Chain-of-Thought).

Core Software Fluency: You possess strong programming skills in Python and TypeScript, coupled with practical experience in cloud engineering, containerisation, and modern DevOps. You know that great agents still require rock-solid software foundations.

High Tolerance for Ambiguity: You are energised by uncertainty and shifting targets. You treat changing requirements as a normal part of frontier work, and you know exactly when to ship a rough prototype to learn quickly versus when to slow down for architectural rigour.

Cross-Disciplinary Communication: You can seamlessly navigate the gap between code and reality, collaborating with clients, roboticists, and scientists to clearly deliver the "art of the possible."

Benefits

Variety of work: Projects spanning biotech, finance, robotics, and beyond. No two engagements look alike.

Continuous learning: A mentoring and learning package shaped by your goals, backed by squad-based knowledge sharing across the company.

Engineering autonomy: A free hand in choosing the right tools and processes. We trust your engineering judgement.

Access to world-class experts: You'll share a building with biologists, roboticists, electronics engineers, and mathematicians. Few places let you tap that range of expertise on a single project.

Hybrid working environment: We're flexible about where you work on a day-to-day basis. We also love the energy of collaborating in person, so we’d love you to be in Cambridge for key meetings.

title: QA Lead
description:
About Foundation Health 

Foundation Health is an AI operating system for pharmacy - built by a team who lived the problem firsthand, not one that came to healthcare from the outside. Every day, prior authorizations delay prescriptions, pharmacists lose hours to paperwork instead of patients, and prescriptions slip through the cracks between health systems. We believe thoughtfully applied AI can finally change that - deep, integrated infrastructure that streamlines how care is coordinated, purpose-built for the complexity of specialty pharmacy.

We're building toward a world where pharmacy teams spend their time on patients, not paperwork - where AI handles the routine so clinicians can focus on what only humans can do. Getting there takes the right people. We're looking for curious, ambitious folks who want to help solve healthcare's hardest problems - for our patients, our partners, and each other.

The Role 

You'd be joining alongside our QA Lead in the US, with real ownership of building this out properly in the UK: strategy, tooling, standards, process — all still very much taking shape. There's no hands-off management here — everybody, at every level, is hands-on, and that includes you.

And because we're AI-native by design, testing here isn't testing conventional software. You'll be leading the charge on how we test AI-led products across the UK — agentic workflows, LLM-based features, non-deterministic behaviour that doesn't fit a traditional pass/fail script.

What you'll actually do: 

- Build out our QA function properly: strategy, process, tooling and standards, working alongside our US QA Lead as we grow this on both sides of the Atlantic

- Design and own testing for AI-driven features: agentic workflows, LLM outputs, evaluation frameworks, and the genuinely hard question of what "correct" even means when a system doesn't behave the same way twice

- Get hands-on with automation using Playwright and TypeScript — and just as hands-on with manual testing, regression and UAT when that's what a release actually needs. This isn't a role where you delegate the manual work away

- Set the bar for how quality gets handled company-wide as we scale — not just catching bugs, but building the culture that prevents them

- Work closely with Engineering and Product to make sure quality is part of how things get built, not a gate bolted on at the end

Who thrives here? 

- Builders, not inheritors. You've either grown a QA function from something small before, or you've been desperate for the chance to. Coming into an established, fully-formed process isn't what excites you — shaping something still taking form is.

- Genuinely fluent in AI, not just aware of it. AI is already part of your day-to-day — you use it properly, and you're curious about pushing it further. And on the testing side, you've either tested AI-led products already or you understand exactly why testing them is a different problem to testing normal software.

- True hybrids, with zero ego about it. You're as comfortable writing a Playwright suite in TypeScript as you are doing hands-on manual testing, regression and UAT. Nobody here delegates the "unglamorous" work away — including you.

- Strong technical fundamentals underneath the modern tooling. Test strategy, defect management, release process — the fundamentals are solid, even if the problems you're applying them to are new.

- People who lead by doing. This role grows into shaping and leading QA in the UK as we scale. But there's no hands-off management track here — whoever's in this role is still testing, still in the detail, still building alongside the team, at every stage of growth.

Product Manager – Compliance

Help Shape the Future of AI Compliance in Financial Services

Aveni is redefining how financial institutions use AI. We build production-ready agentic systems that reshape how banks, advisers, and financial services firms operate, replacing fragmented processes with intelligent, end-to-end workflows. Recognized as Fintech of the Year for two consecutive years and awarded Best Specialist Technology Service at the Professional Adviser Awards 2025, we are backed by leading investors and supported by major financial institutions as we scale rapidly amid accelerating AI adoption in financial services.

Our platform enables some of the UK’s largest financial institutions to deploy AI safely in FCA-regulated environments, powering everything from compliance monitoring to AI-driven adviser guidance.

We are seeking a Product Manager – Assurance to play a central role in Aveni’s Assurance portfolio: products that help financial services firms govern, test, and assure AI agents and human interactions across the customer journey.

The Role

This role is primarily focused on Agent Approve, Aveni’s pre-deployment simulation and testing product, with additional responsibility for Detect, our post-interaction compliance assessment product.

Agent Approve is a growth-stage product operating in a dynamic regulatory environment. You will own the product from discovery through commercial readiness, helping define Aveni’s position in an emerging market.

This is a hands-on, high-ownership product role. You will collaborate closely with the Head of Assurance Products on strategy and roadmap direction while independently driving discovery, prioritisation, delivery, and go-to-market readiness. You will work with engineering, design, customer success, marketing, and commercial teams to turn complex customer and regulatory problems into clear, valuable, and shippable product outcomes.

You are well suited to this role if you enjoy operating in ambiguity, can bring structure to complex problem spaces, and possess the judgement to prioritize effectively, distinguishing what matters, what can wait, and what needs validation before building.

What You’ll Be Doing

- Own the Agent Approve and Detect product roadmaps from problem discovery and opportunity sizing through prioritisation, delivery, and launch readiness.

- Lead continuous discovery with customers, prospects, and internal stakeholders, developing an evidence-based view of market direction and urgent problem areas.

- Translate ideas and customer problems into low- and high-fidelity prototypes to validate assumptions early, reduce delivery risk, and accelerate decision-making.

- Collaborate closely with engineering and design to convert strategy into executable delivery plans, maintain a prioritized backlog, and support squads through delivery.

- Build strong relationships across engineering, commercial, customer success, and marketing, serving as a trusted voice on what we are building, why it matters, and how it supports Aveni's Assurance portfolio.

- Stay current with industry trends, regulatory developments, and competitor activity in financial services compliance, QA technology, and AI assurance, ensuring product decisions are grounded in market context.

- Use data and metrics to inform prioritization, define product KPIs, and measure the success of features and capabilities.

What We’re Looking For

- Proven experience as a Product Manager in a B2B SaaS environment, ideally owning a roadmap from discovery to delivery.

- Domain expertise in financial services, compliance, risk, or regulatory technology, and experience leading stakeholder discovery and translating insights into product strategy.

- Strong product judgement, clear communication skills, and confidence in shaping problem spaces, defining direction, defending prioritization decisions, and explaining trade-offs to diverse audiences.

- Analytical rigor, comfort using data to guide decisions, and ability to build trusted relationships with engineers, designers, and senior commercial stakeholders.

- Self-directed, proactive individuals comfortable in early-stage or ambiguous product environments where the path is not fully defined.

Nice to Have

- Experience with AI-powered products, analytics, or model-driven tooling; familiarity with FCA regulatory frameworks, Consumer Duty, or conduct risk.

- Exposure to pre-deployment testing, quality assurance, or compliance workflows.

- Experience writing compelling product narratives for commercial or go-to-market purposes, especially relevant for the growth-stage nature of Agent Approve.

You will work on complex and meaningful challenges at the intersection of AI, regulation, and financial services. You will help shape a product category that is growing in importance as financial institutions move from experimenting with AI to deploying it safely, responsibly, and at scale.
